body:
Peltola's puzzling priorities ... | | | |

| | |
---
|
## **Mary Peltola skips another week of work to go fishing**
Dear Friends,

You'll think I'm joking, but I'm not: _**Mary Peltola is skipping another week of session to go fishing**_.

After a week of recess, the House is back in session — but **once again, Mary isn't there**. Despite already having one of the worst attendance records in the House, Alaska’s only representative is unfortunately absent this week because she has decided fishing takes priority.

Don't get me wrong: I love fishing. It's how we put food on our tables, and it's an important part of our Alaskan culture.

**But Alaska has one seat in the House — _just one_. **_**We can’t afford to have a part-timer in that seat.**_

Crucial votes are being cast, and critical discussions are happening on the House floor -- and every day that Mary misses is a day that Alaska is completely unrepresented.

This is the time when our representative should be fighting for our interests, ensuring our voices are heard, and working tirelessly to address the issues that affect Alaskans every day. We need someone who is fully committed to representing us, someone who understands the importance of showing up and being present for every vote and every debate. We need a leader who prioritizes the needs of Alaskans.

Some suspect that Mary Peltola is skipping the week in D.C. to avoid answering tough questions from the press about President Biden's mental acuity. After praising Biden earlier this year as "one of the smartest, sharpest people [she's] met in DC," she has had to bob and weave to avoid revisiting that topic with the press. She told a reporter this week that because Biden — her endorsed candidate — _** **_ is going to lose Alaska by a substantial margin, her opinion on Biden's mental state was "irrelevant" .

_**Unfortunately, if she can't be convinced to show up for votes, it'll be her that becomes irrelevant — and Alaska will suffer for it. **_

As your candidate for Congress, I promise to bring the dedication and work ethic that Alaska deserves. But I can't do it without you, and your support. Please [_**click here**_](https://alaskansfornickbegich.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8aeb8c45837a089b0eee9add8&id=740035c70c&e=6679001ba0) to make a contribution. Your financial support is much-needed, greatly appreciated — and we'll put it to the best possible use: taking Alaska's seat back!

Join me in calling for accountability and supporting a new direction for Alaska. Let's work together to secure a brighter future for our state. Together, we can bring the change Alaska needs and ensure that our voices are always represented in Washington.

Thank you for your support.

Best regards,

Nick Begich

**PS**. The August primary is coming up quick! Make sure you **mark August 20th on the calendar** and make a plan to _**vote**_! NB

| | Peter,
If I didn’t see the headlines myself, I’d think this was satire.

**Tim Kaine launched a thank-you tour for HIMSELF to honor his 30 years in elected office.
**
That’s 30 years of putting DC insiders before the people of our Commonwealth, 30 years of bumping elbows with powerful lobbyists, and 30 years of dining out on the taxpayer dime.

**And what is he calling this grandstand? A “Salute to Service!”**

Let me tell you, Tim Kaine knows NOTHING about service.

While he was sitting in a fitted suit in Washington DC fighting a growing waistline, I was fighting on the front lines with U.S. Navy Special Operations for 25 years.

While he was at fancy dinner parties, I was defusing bombs in Iraq and Afghanistan for Navy SEALS and Army Special Forces.

While Tim Kaine was bankrupting our country, I was keeping it safe.

**To say that he’s served our country is a disgusting offense to every veteran and active duty servicemember who has put their lives on the line for America.**

**[The ONLY thing Tim Kaine should be celebrating is his retirement on election day after the people of Virginia vote him out of office. name: Alsobrooks HQ
subject: It's Your Weekly Team Alsobrooks Newsletter!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alsobrooks for Senate
body:
|
---
[ ](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/2092?t=1&akid=1985%2E52803%2EOqrT6d)

| | Greetings #Team Alsobrooks, Another great week on the campaign trail! In case you missed it, here’s what’s been happening on the campaign trail and beyond: We started off our Fourth of July at the Dundalk Fourth of July Parade! Thanks to everyone who joined us. [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/28107?t=30&amount=25&akid=1985%2E52803%2EOqrT6d) Next up – Towson! Thank you for the warm welcome at your Fourth of July Parade! So great to see so many supporters and familiar faces! [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/28107?t=32&amount=25&akid=1985%2E52803%2EOqrT6d) [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/28107?t=33&amount=25&akid=1985%2E52803%2EOqrT6d) Thank you Catonsville! Our team had a blast marching in your Fourth of July parade! Looking forward to being back soon. [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/28107?t=34&amount=25&akid=1985%2E52803%2EOqrT6d) From Takoma Park to Montgomery Village, Team Maryland joined Congressman Jamie Raskin and April Delaney to march in celebration of our nation’s independence and the values and freedoms that we hold dear. Across our state, we made our collective voice heard. Now, let's make our voice heard by delivering victories for all the amazing Democrats running up and down the ticket. [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/28107?t=35&amount=25&akid=1985%2E52803%2EOqrT6d) [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/28107?t=36&amount=25&akid=1985%2E52803%2EOqrT6d) [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/28107?t=37&amount=25&akid=1985%2E52803%2EOqrT6d) Our last parade of the day – Annapolis! Great to be with Comptroller Brooke Lierman, State Senator Sarah Elfreth, Councilman Pete Smith, and Delegate Dana Jones. To all of the Team Alsobrooks supporters who joined on the trail, thank you! [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/28107?t=38&amount=25&akid=1985%2E52803%2EOqrT6d) We visited the Bykota Senior Center in Towson, one of Baltimore County’s busiest facilities, to hear directly from county seniors about the issues that matter to them. We spoke about concerns over this Supreme Court, protecting our democracy, and the need to keep the Senate to ensure we can build an economy that works for everyone. Thank you to Delegate N. Scott Phillips and Council member Julian Jones Jr. for joining! [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/28107?t=20&amount=25&akid=1985%2E52803%2EOqrT6d) Thank you to Dr. Ben and Kim Stallings for hosting us in Silver Spring! It was great to see so many familiar faces and to talk with healthcare providers about how we are going to protect reproductive care, reduce the cost of health care, and deliver for all Marylanders. [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/28107?t=21&amount=25&akid=1985%2E52803%2EOqrT6d) From Garrett County to the Eastern Shore, Team Alsobrooks started off our Weekend of Action in FULL FORCE. We were out across Maryland, hitting the pavement, knocking doors, and getting out the vote all weekend. [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/28107?t=22&amount=25&akid=1985%2E52803%2EOqrT6d) Next up on the weekend of action: canvass launches in Largo, Howard, and Anne Arundel with State Senator Sarah Elfreth. Shoutout to all the folks on Team Maryland who were out that day ready to send Sarah to Congress and our movement to the Senate! [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/28107?t=23&amount=25&akid=1985%2E52803%2EOqrT6d) From Columbia to Anne Arundel County, our weekend of action was a huge success! Team Maryland hit the pavement, knocked on over 12k doors, got out the vote, and made our collective voice heard. Special thank you to all of the elected officials who joined us out on the trail! [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/28107?t=24&amount=25&akid=1985%2E52803%2EOqrT6d) No better way to end our weekend of action than by meeting with so many D9 friends and familiar faces in Baltimore! Thank you to Lamont Riley for hosting us, to Dr. David Heiber for moderating a fantastic live podcast, and to Councilman James Torrence, Councilwoman Phylicia Porter, and Senator Antonio Hayes for joining us. [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/28107?t=25&amount=25&akid=1985%2E52803%2EOqrT6d) A packed house in Rockville! Thank you to Michael Strauss for hosting and all who joined us to talk about our grassroots movement and how we are going to keep Maryland blue! We’re fired up and ready to win! [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/28107?t=26&amount=25&akid=1985%2E52803%2EOqrT6d) The Alsobrooks X Raskin Democracy Summer collab is in full effect! Shoutout to all the students who are a part of this democracy fellowship and came out in full force to canvass on behalf of our campaigns. [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/28107?t=27&amount=25&akid=1985%2E52803%2EOqrT6d) What a great morning attending Sunday Service at The Sanctuary at the Kingdom Square. Thank you to Bishop Maclin and First Lady Peggy Maclin for the invitation and warm welcome. On Graduation Sunday, Angela was proud to help present scholarships to the AMAZING high school students! [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/28107?t=28&amount=25&akid=1985%2E52803%2EOqrT6d) [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/28107?t=29&amount=25&akid=1985%2E52803%2EOqrT6d) **In the News** The Baltimore Sun: **[Opinion Hogan a nonpartisan? History tells a different tale](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/28134?t=7&akid=1985%2E52803%2EOqrT6d)** Herald-Mail Media: **[Political notebook: Cardin, state’s teacher’s union endorse Alsobrooks for US Senate](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/28135?t=8&akid=1985%2E52803%2EOqrT6d)**
_“Outgoing U.S. Sen. Ben Cardin, D-Md., first endorsed Prince George's County Executive Angela Alsobrooks as his successor on May 14 as Maryland's primary election results were being tabulated.”_ **GET INVOLVED** Sign up to volunteer to join our organizing efforts for the General Election and an organizer will reach out soon! **[Sign up to volunteer here](http://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/9785?t=9&akid=1985%2E52803%2EOqrT6d)**. **In the meantime, we have to talk to Lottie, Dottie, and everybody!** Download our Alsobrooks App and get the latest campaign updates straight to your phone so you can text your friends. We won this primary by mobilizing thousands of supporters to talk to thousands of their friends. We are going to have to do it again and on an even bigger scale. Download the app to get started at **[angelaalsobrooks.com/app](http://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/12441?t=10&akid=1985%2E52803%2EOqrT6d)**. **We are launching our Alsobrooks Summer Fellowship!** Are you a high school or college student looking to learn about campaigns? Do you know some young people looking to get involved with the campaign? Then have them join our fellowship program! Fellows are volunteers who commit 5 to 10 hours per week to talk to voters, help at events, and contribute to special projects. Apply at **[angelaalsobrooks.com/fellowship](http://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/9723?t=11&akid=1985%2E52803%2EOqrT6d)**. **Want to work on Team Alsobrooks? We’re hiring!** We have a large variety of positions we need to fill, including dozens of field organizers across the state. See what jobs we have opening and apply at **[angelaalsobrooks.com/jobs](http://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/28136?t=12&akid=1985%2E52803%2EOqrT6d)**. Here on Team Alsobrooks, we’re proud to be a campaign powered by grassroots donors. We believe in Angela's ability to go further and do better for our communities, and we know you do too! It’s going to take all of us working together to get Angela over the finish line this November. | | | [Volunteer](https://alsobrooks.actionkit.com/signup/volunteer-form?t=13&akid=1985%2E52803%2EOqrT6d)
---
| | [Find Events Near You](http://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/12166?t=14&akid=1985%2E52803%2EOqrT6d)
---
| | [Donate](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/28107?t=31&amount=25&akid=1985%2E52803%2EOqrT6d)
---
**SOCIALS**
While we'll keep sending emails to keep you updated, the best way to keep up with Angela is on our social media channels. Follow us on Twitter, Facebook, and Instagram to follow along with us on the campaign trail!
| | [Facebook](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/8814?t=15&akid=1985%2E52803%2EOqrT6d)
---
| | [Twitter](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/8815?t=16&akid=1985%2E52803%2EOqrT6d)
---
| | [Instagram](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/8816?t=17&akid=1985%2E52803%2EOqrT6d)
---
Sincerely,
Team Alsobrooks

| | [ ](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/89?t=2&akid=1985%2E52803%2EOqrT6d)
---

---

---
They say a picture’s worth a thousand words, but how about a gif? That’s like a hundred pictures in one... and this one really says it all. [ ](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/46471?t=7&akid=21683%2E4449941%2EJIFxkr) [**Seriously. If you do one thing today, can it be splitting a contribution between my friend Josh Riley’s campaign for Congress in NY-19 and Fight for Reform to help them elect state and local Democrats?**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/46471?t=8&akid=21683%2E4449941%2EJIFxkr) | [GIVE TO JOSH. THANK YOU! »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/46471?t=9&akid=21683%2E4449941%2EJIFxkr)
---
Josh’s race is one of the most competitive in the entire country, and national Democrats just named it one of the top flip opportunities we need to win to take back the House. **It’s also a great opportunity to beat up on a truly insufferable Republican, which you know is almost as important.**

A few months ago Marc Molinaro (Josh’s opponent) told a bunch of reporters how stupid he thinks everyone he represents is. He said they wouldn’t know what was going on in Washington if “he backed over them with a pickup truck.”

| | | I endured the gauntlet of West Point Military Academy, then boot camp, then became a Tank Platoon Leader in the final days of the Cold War.

I briefed President Trump on America's most classified matters of national security while Director of CIA.

And I stood eye-to-eye with the most dangerous dictators in the world as Trump's Secretary of State.

**It takes a lot to make me feel on edge. So the fact that I 'm even sending you this email should give you pause. **

Because I'm afraid we have a problem. A big one.

I just got word that Joe Biden and the Democrats are _closer than they 've ever been before_ to destroying our Conservative House Majority once and for all. The latest reports show they've stockpiled over $100,000,000 to defeat us in enough swing states to bring forth a COMPLETE LIBERAL TAKEOVER.

The ONLY THING standing in the way of Joe Biden having full control - and ramming through any radical policy he wants - is just a few competitive House seats. That's it.

I don't tell you this lightly and I know that's not what you want to see happen to our country.

_**[That's why I'm rushing to you, in partnership with Majority Leader Steve Scalise, to raise a game-changing one million dollars in the next 72 hours.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=ea999bbe260a44d9bd21c106b443b73c&_e=AX7bduIOwkQyU9OiQO1aNbBVePrmK00OEJ9Y-T44ms0dFIVrZR2--Jl_FL3oykLl_LOxHFeSxpTfuGXCTttqHRradCVQmpO88yJfHpOR4XXpDu4GT0aFOMqKXHsdPxtcnkwx4bjf4qAVHBxfpySg5Y8a8uCHjJVavsH0DsrieuqG1HBDoxAYG4pplZmyHa2r8xscD6CG-7vJbBlOB6kmBJVzU1bmS4kpVe5P4457WjDiLottLKdxfAC_AVMyxy_fT7rhNnx76bmMDlDpQOtSV1fXgAZxMyBDxkTXeDVrbBWtEEjqrRFONmWAruSALOMYeeq3jiwtBAGB_9WEGjjSA0t7s7WWbVx2WMeN-tABecSP263qbUxv_q3AcHtYX-_-T-c8AA9F2eGZEwWoQaA1eA%3D%3D "That’s why I’m rushing to you, in partnership with Majority Leader Steve Scalise, to raise a game-changing one million dollars in the next 72 hours.")**_ I know what you're thinking... that's not enough runway to raise that much. | [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/71533?t=6&akid=15483%2E878179%2EGsrjD3) Hey folks, Jon Tester here.

I’m not like most of my colleagues in the Senate, and it’s not too hard to see why. All you have to do is look at my $12 flattop haircut and my collection of dirt-stained t-shirts.

**I’m the Senate’s only working farmer, and damn proud of it.**

Yes, it can make for early mornings and late nights during planting and harvest seasons—but it keeps me grounded, and gives me a unique perspective on issues. Like how climate change affects my farm, or how rural communities like mine need high-speed internet.

**These are real challenges that deserve real solutions, and that’s what I’m fighting for in Washington. But political experts rank my seat as one of the most likely to flip red, so I need your help to beat the odds and win this critical race:**

[**Can you split a donation between the Voter Protection Project and my campaign? We need to raise another $10 to reach our fundraising goal. When a signature on a ballot doesn't match other signatures the government has for you in their databases, then those ballots remain unopened and get set aside and put into what's called a **" cure list"**, meaning the ballot needs to be fixed or cured.**You might be on that cure list and have no idea.** Unfortunately, **even though they can and should,** the majority of county clerks are refusing to provide us with that list, so we aren't able to contact these individuals directly to let them know that they need to cure their ballot.So we are asking each of you to **take a couple of minutes to quickly check the ballot tracking website to ensure your vote was counted. If you find that it wasn't you need to immediately contact your county clerk, you may even have to go in person. Please also encourage your family, friends, and neighbors to do the same.**
## [**The deadline for this is TODAY!**](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-ekhjlx-trihsurjy-i/)
## [**Don't wait, click now to check your ballot status:**](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-ekhjlx-trihsurjy-d/)
[CLICK HERE TO TRACK YOUR BALLOT](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-ekhjlx-trihsurjy-h/)
# BACKGROUND:
### Each county has to have their final canvass done by Tuesday, some have already completed theirs, even as ballots were still being returned or processed.
### This isn't simply just waiting for ballots to arrive and then counting them, there are many other factors to consider:
* ### -Provisional ballots are cast when a voter doesn't receive a ballot in the mail or goes to vote in person but they aren't on the voter list. These must be reviewed to determine voter eligibility before they can be counted

* ### -There are sometimes ballots that get rejected and set aside to be reviewed because voter intent couldn't be determined. This can be because the ballot wasn't properly filled out. These ballots are reviewed by two election judges and if the intent is clear then they get counted in the final tally.

* ### -Postmark issues. There are many ballots that were postmarked after the deadline that are being rejected. This year, we have a unique situation where many counties in Southern Utah now have their mail routed through Las Vegas as it is a closer hub than Salt Lake City. This has caused delays in ballots being returned and many of those ballots have late postmarks yet voters are telling us that they are positive they returned their ballot before the deadline. Read this Deseret News article to understand what we are referring to: [A recount just became more likely in the 2nd Congressional District Republican primary](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-ekhjlx-trihsurjy-k/):
* \--..."a late influx of 350 unprocessed ballots that arrived in Washington County from the U.S. Postal Service distribution center in Las Vegas on Tuesday -- one week after Election Day."
* \--..."It was kind of a surprise to us to see," Washington County Clerk Ryan Sullivan told the Deseret News."

[](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-ekhjlx-trihsurjy-u/) [READ Iron County Commissioner refuses to certify primary election results amid controversy](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-ekhjlx-trihsurjy-o/)
* ### -CURING YOUR BALLOT: There are also mail-in ballots that don't get counted because the signature on the ballot doesn't match the government database. When this happens, the ballots get put on what is called a "cure list", or a list of ballots to be cured. This process includes outreach to voters via the contact information they provided on their ballot. Campaigns often have more contact information for voters than the clerks do, and they are far more motivated to contact these voters to have them cure their ballot.
* * ### \--Cure ballots are not opened until the signature is verified - therefore nobody knows who these individuals have voted for.
* ### \--Races in Utah have been won by getting voters to cure their ballots.
* ### \--Some counties give out the list when it is request, yet others are refusing to do so.
* ### \--The law seems pretty clear that if the list is requested, they must provide it. [Utah Code 20A-3a-401(12) states: ](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-ekhjlx-trihsurjy-b/)
* \---"if, in response to a request, and in accordance with the requirements of law, an election officer discloses the name or address of voters whose ballots have been rejected and not yet resolved, the election officer shall: (a)make the disclosure within two business days after the day on which the request is made; (b)respond to each request in the order the requests were made; and(c)make each disclosure in a manner, and within a period of time, that does not reflect favoritism to one requestor over another.
* **\--We have been trying to get these cure lists for almost two weeks now.** Salt Lake County has given it to us, **but others refuse**.

* \--Washington County has been our best performing county and is one where ballots come through the Las Vegas postal hub and **they have nearly 500 ballots still to be cured, and they must be cured by today.**
*
* **\-- They are refusing to give us the list.**..there is no logical reason to not share the list with campaigns. There are no voter privacy concerns, these aren't protected records, this is just like campaigns getting voter lists and lists of people who have already voted - the point is to have as many sources as possible contacting these voters to make sure their vote is counted.

### We have retained lawyers and are exploring all sorts of scenarios to make sure all legal and eligible votes are counted
###
[DONATE TO HELP US FIGHT TO GET EVERY VOTE COUNTED](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-ekhjlx-trihsurjy-n/) [](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-ekhjlx-trihsurjy-p/)[](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-ekhjlx-trihsurjy-x/)[](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-ekhjlx-trihsurjy-m/)[](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-ekhjlx-trihsurjy-c/)[](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-ekhjlx-trihsurjy-s/) [](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-ekhjlx-trihsurjy-g/) [ Share ](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-fb-ekhjlx-trihsurjy-yd/) [ Tweet ](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-tw-ekhjlx-trihsurjy-yh/) [ Share ](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-li-ekhjlx-trihsurjy-yk/) [ Forward ](https://colbyjenkinsforcongress.forwardtomyfriend.com/t-trihsurjy-F0A48A54-ekhjlx-l-yu) | Paid for by Colby Jenkins for Congress You are receiving this email because you have been identified as an Utah voter, or you have subscribed through our website. name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: this email could be illegal next year
body:
And we’re no strangers to this kind of treatment...
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

President Trump just got convicted by our (in)justice system of 34 felony counts for what amounts to nothing more than a paperwork violation.

That **_SHOCKED_** many Americans. But the truth is, those who stand for Life are no strangers to this kind of treatment under the Biden administration.

>From day one of his presidency, President Biden’s Department of Justice has had pro-lifers in their crosshairs – including sentencing 75-year-old Paulette Harlow to two years in prison for praying outside of an abortion facility!

Paulette Harlow is a DYING grandmother. At her sentencing, the judge snickered, _“Make every effort to stay alive”_ while in jail.

_Meanwhile, a gang of teenagers in Chicago beat up a pregnant couple, killing their preborn child, and they only got probation_.

**Pro-Life Friend, I know the media LOVES the Biden Administration’s third-world tactics!**

But I want to know what you think about all of this . . .

**[So, can I count on you to please fill out _Students for Life Action’s_ LAWFARE SURVEY IMMEDIATELY](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gjlkuuk-duchtdja-y/)?**

If you and I don’t send a LOUD-AND-CLEAR message against this madness, I’m worried the great “defenders of Democracy” in the Biden administration will start hurling you and me in jail – simply for being pro-life.

If that sounds unbelievable, the University of Maryland’s START project – which is affiliated with the Department of Homeland Security – listed us _**as a terrorist group!**_

That’s why I’m counting on your IMMEDIATE action.

| **_Students for Life Action_**
📊 **Polling Department** 📊

[**[POLL] Is the Biden Administration engaging in “lawfare” against political enemies?**](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gjlkuuk-duchtdja-j/)

[**YES! >>**](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gjlkuuk-duchtdja-t/)
[**No >>**](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gjlkuuk-duchtdja-i/)

---

**[Please fill out your Lawfare Survey as soon as possible](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gjlkuuk-duchtdja-d/).**

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

name: No Dem Left Behind
subject: The Senate Map in 2024
body:
Here is everything you need to know about the most important Senate races in 2024.
| | | | | | [](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2u1oem-e2d8wd-kyd76rh8/ "logo")
---
# Senate Map 2024
---
| [](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2u1oem-e2d8we-kyd76rh9/)
---
**Key 2024 Senate Races:**
**Montana: Jon Tester** Jon Tester is a seasoned political survivor, having won three tough elections in conservative-leaning Montana. Despite the state’s GOP tilt, Tester has built a strong political brand, appealing to Independents and Republicans alike. In 2024, he faces Tim Sheehy, a former Navy SEAL endorsed by Trump. Winning this seat is critical for Democrats to maintain their majority and continue pushing forward on key issues.

### **Ohio: Sherrod Brown**
Sherrod Brown, known for his strong populist appeal, is seeking a fourth term in a state that has become increasingly red. Despite this shift, Brown has consistently won over Independents and some conservative voters. He faces businessman Bernie Moreno in what promises to be one of the most expensive and closely watched races. Holding onto Ohio is essential for Democrats to protect Social Security and other vital social programs for rural America.
###

### **Pennsylvania: Bob Casey Jr.**
Senator Bob Casey Jr. is running for a fourth term in Pennsylvania, a key battleground state. Casey has a history of winning comfortably, thanks to strong support in Democratic strongholds like Philadelphia and Pittsburgh and solid performance in working-class areas. His opponent, David McCormick, could pose a significant challenge by appealing to suburban voters. A victory here is crucial for sustaining Democratic efforts and holding onto a vital battleground state.

### **Wisconsin: Tammy Baldwin**
Senator Tammy Baldwin is seeking a third term in Wisconsin, a state marked by political polarization. Baldwin has a track record of winning over rural and exurban voters while dominating in Democratic strongholds. With prominent Republicans opting out of the race, Baldwin faces businessman Eric Hovde who has massive backing from MAGA donors. Securing Wisconsin is vital for Democrats to continue their work on climate change and social justice.

### **Texas: Colin Allred vs. Ted Cruz**
While Texas has been a Republican stronghold, Democrats see an opportunity with Colin Allred, a former NFL player and civil rights attorney. Allred faces the incumbent Ted Cruz, who narrowly won in 2018. Allred's ability to appeal to moderates and flip a GOP-held district in Dallas makes this race one to watch. Winning Texas would be a monumental shift, significantly impacting the Senate balance and advancing the Democratic agenda.

### **Importance of Defending the Senate**
### Winning these races is not just about individual states; it’s about defending a Democratic majority that can continue to champion critical issues. Abortion rights, climate change action, and Social Security protection are all on the line. With leaders like Jon Tester, Sherrod Brown, Bob Casey, Tammy Baldwin, and Colin Allred, Democrats have the potential to bring transformative change and secure a better future for all Americans.
[**_The 2024 Senate races are a must-win for Democrats to maintain control and drive progress on essential issues. Each of these states plays a crucial role in determining the Senate's composition and the direction of national policies. By supporting these key races, we can ensure continued leadership that prioritizes the needs of all Americans._**](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2u1oem-e2d8wf-kyd76rh0/)

## Biden Tells Dems to Unite Behind Him
President Biden [sent a letter ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLtu7CAUAL_G7ljB4WEoKG6z3d42pcXjsD4RNpZNvMrfR5s65Wia0Xw85kegStvzf1jR99LmkDpdOE_MMVCzGrMviIByRC8m4FqCtmpc_GStMkqiS2iKtFZmg6XoGJUyRmIeyQMHxSfuBOdCwa3oYkvOIjow1ok4KI6Zejtun422vmCp3-3C45baOla_9L6fg_w3wH2Ae9g3fJ1v9YajU6o4wD1Sxo2lsO6Bnhtb2teJLOPa0hH6yU7cQkcmTAKAYkFrbXPkwnBnuI4yZDcpCOPh8_6iWuk006D4cw1UfzP6n08uDz8BAAD__4NyYkQ)to congressional Democrats on Monday, telling lawmakers he would not step down and demanding the party unite behind his leadership. In the letter, [linked here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskD1vwyAUAH8NbI4ez3wODF2ypWtHC8wjocImwshR_32Vzh1PN5x0X7flFkot-_0zbORHbktYRzlpMZObUC6SJ5-JkGZOXhgENaOykj-8BrQmWK0iKe3I2mxRzCLmiIqyXXnxCCjBgBMAQuIlq2xzSiI61NaJyCRQKqP1y3cr-3hQrj_tpH5Z28arf4zxPNj8wfDK8BqeO72Ot3pDH2WtxPAaS6J9qjQG9SnR1tYexjFJpTEYDGEO1glSCrXQwiRI0skEwLtPz1eptRzaMAn3LZT61x3_Tjg9_gYAAP__Uc1cVg), Biden wrote that he has had conversations with party leaders, elected officials, and voters and believes he is "the best person to beat Donald Trump in 2024." Biden also called into [a morning news show](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLtu6zAQBb-G6igsVw-KBYvbqPNtUwp8LK0NJNEQGSv--8Cp05zmADPAfNyWm-ONj_t_t5OtKS8uVH7SoqWR2C99E20iQuoaskojDB0OU9-sNowwgIeRtB9CZ5IHE7RySsXBOI-xYYuAPWgwCkD12KYhTSlG5Q2Ok1Fe9ECRaz7bz8xHXSltr_yksw15bza71vooovsncBY4X9fVum_O5f0KnN9sgTPo90wCZ8-RDrnmr0Ky0OEqyUh7DqerRZbqXnzcJR_ydIGa08bHxdvGZdSih_vuePvV1j8bPC3-BAAA__8r0l29) on Monday and blasted the party "elites" trying to push him out, saying the average voter wants him to stay in the race. A recent poll found that 72% of [registered voters want](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1u7CAUhJ8Gd1hwwD8UFLdxt7dNaWE4rM8GmxVGdvL2kVOnmWJGmk_6Ph7zw1Gi_fnfbWhrzLPzlU6cB2446Fk3wUZEQNWglQOITkE36ma1XnV-kEp3MYLSsu-Mg6VHBAMmRBUasiBAi0EYKYTU0MYujjEEuRjoRyMXpgUGqrm0r0x7XTGm73xiaX3emmTXWt8HU_8YTAym67pa90X5uFcG0_3NYBLDHSODaaGAO99y2Wl_8ldG_i543GUll3hxHnl0vnK_ov9sig3vi1Kiox-YFs_NUfoF1z8tnBZ-AgAA__-iS14P) Biden to exit the race, up from 63% in February.
## Boeing to Plead Guilty for 737 Max Crashes
Boeing is [set to plead guilty](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7GOtCAURp8GOgxcUaCg-Bu7-dstzRUuIxuUiZJx9-03br3dl3wnOTkfj_mBueT9-R838i3VGUPLb5qNcAL0rHn0iQio5-SVATn0MFjNV29GisZJXAjQSrQpgJLOJgcj9sEMPHuQoKWRTkmpNHRpSDbFqBYHo3VqYVpSzK0e3WfNe1sple_6pqMLdePFr629Ttb_YzAxmK7r6sJy7nSd989guieDaamU96d4FUIRCYswvREbfolw4LnSjfDDx9eVS8nnaJiWzw1z-bW0P5PfHn4CAAD__4HYWHQ) to criminal fraud conspiracy related to the fatal crashes of two 737 MAX airplanes in 2018 and 2019. Under the plea deal, pending a federal judge's approval, the company would face a [$243.6 million fine](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDGvrCAUhH8Ndhg4omhB8Rq7fe0rDcJBzwvIBtn17r-_8da3mWQymcnk-_dYHpYiHdtfm9DUkBfrKr1x0XzioBbVeBMQAbsGjdQg-g76UTW7CWtAPUjphFRWWcBJrf2oUaDsFQ6hIQMClNBikkJIBW3owxi8l-sEwzjJlSmBnmou7f9MR90xxE9-Y2ldTk00e63Pk3V_GMwM5uu6Wnes7g4ZzPc0g1noW0YG85qRjo3XzJ8Rrefbi2L93N4VSnTYyEOxL8_dbsuG_KyY0t0IJSeuO82T_eKu2HPHs91rik0x_nlRjHQOmimxJUvx51v9FdTbwHcAAAD__9aFauU) and three years' oversight by a corporate probation monitor. Additionally, Boeing must invest $455 million in compliance and safety programs and agree to board meetings with crash victims' families. [The guilty plea](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGyoyAUgOGnwQ4HjiChoNjGLttu6SAc9GQQMsom17e_k1vf_iv--f_d57unTGX963d0LdXZh0YvnA23HNSsuugSIuDQoZMGhB5A31S3uWAkmgWTBe0XbcKISUktR6WSGJRNHTkQoIQRVgohFfRJp1uKUS4WxpuVC1MCI7V69I9KpW2Y8lVfePSh7l12W2vPkw1_GEwMpkTFl4D95bdaP4LBVPB9MpiWilRW3ip_ZvSRr_8pt4tT4bE-ePAn8kYYPyCij_niZjB89188HP7c8OQShNWjHGW_tT13h4vPN-VM52iYEuvuKf9EtV8PvRx8BwAA__-Q0GiJ) gives Boeing a criminal conviction, which may complicate its ability to secure future government contracts. Those deals accounted for 32% of its $78 billion annual revenue in 2023.
## Beryl Leaves Millions Without Power
Hurricane Beryl hit Texas Monday, killing two and leaving [more than 2 million people](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDGPpSAUhX8Ndhi8IEpBsY3d23ZLg3JRNihG7uh7_37i1NOc5uScfPn-vcaXiynuy1-3oaWQRzdTvHDsuOGgRlV5GxABZYW26UC0EtpeVauVUjplemg0dIid1q0OwRjURk9S9r6KFgQo0QnTCNEoqEMb-uB9MxnQvWkmpgT6SPms_-e404ohffKFZz3nrUp2JToKk38YDAyG-77reZ_mp2QwPNcMBtE90TMYCN-u8BNL9LhT4ZST55Q5vg-ciR_5xpPnL3ILFh5Szj7uC3eFT3h-Et_yhYXPKRc8n1lyuw8upXqlLVWn9ccdU4pFd0yJZXMx_VDSr8ouC98BAAD__8Lzbwg) and businesses without power in the Houston area and knocking down hundreds of trees. body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vs_0whCW_N

Do you ever despair that Jesus will never return?

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/os_0whCW_N

Hello
Friend,
Do you
ever despair that Jesus will never return?
When we
all get to Heaven, what a day of rejoicing that will be!
When we
all see Jesus, we'll sing and shout the victory!
The words
of this old hymn say it perfectly ... Christ's return is going to
be glorious!
But
between now and then, how should we live? What does God's Word
say about end times? As the world grows increasingly sinful ...
what should our response be?

When I
have those kinds of questions, I turn to the book of Revelation,
which I've found helps provide answers and strength in these dark
days.
And
today, I'm pleased to offer you my verse-by-verse study of the
book of Revelation entitled Final Conquest.
Final
Conquest is my first commentary on the book of Revelation. It's
all about the return of Jesus Christ, the most hope-filled event
in human history.
This book
will help you face the future with confidence! God doesn't want
you to live in fear. Final Conquest will unpack God's plan as
never before - you'll be encouraged!

With your
generous donation to Pathway to Victory-- to help keep our
ministry strong, for you and your family, and for listeners and
viewers across the country--I will send you a copy of Final
Conquest for free!
You can
make your most generous donation here:
https://secure.ptv.org/final-conquest-generous-gift-kit-1
One day
soon the darkness will pass...and our long-awaited King of kings
and Lord of lords will return and make His final conquest.
Until
that moment, we are focusing our hope on Christ and working
together to proclaim the gospel and expand His coming kingdom.

Sincerely,
Dr.
Robert Jeffress
Senior
Pastor, First Baptist Dallas

Greetings Peter,

How many errors can you have before it affects an election? A 12-20% failure rate in any industry would be unconscionable, yet these are the error rates seen in United Sovereign Americans (USA) election analysis.

United Sovereign Americans is a unique organization of volunteers who audit our elections to prove whether elections are legally compliant. All of this analysis seeks to highlight the law that officials must follow. The analysis is compiled into state score cards. Our analysis asks these core questions:

1. Were the voter roles accurate at the time the election was administered?

2. Were the votes counted from provably eligible voters?

3. Did the number of votes counted equal the number of votes cast?

4. Do election returns have a reliability within the 0.0008% error permitted by law?

The score card from Michigan shows the state records are inaccurate, and riddled with bad data, including millions of votes altered post certification, but our law demands accuracy. United Sovereign Americans intends to sue the responsible parties in federal court, based on the officials’ own data. USA has two active civil rights lawsuits in Maryland and Pennsylvania, and more member states like Michigan have scorecards outlining election violations, with lawsuits forthcoming.

# [During WWI, Americans called sauerkraut “liberty cabbage.”](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgcrxy&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
### [U.S. History](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgcrxy&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgcrxy&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
| A mericans have a long tradition of rebranding any foods that bear the name of a rival nation during times of conflict. When France refused to support the United States’ war in Iraq in 2003, for example, the cafeteria menus in three congressional office buildings in Washington, D.C., changed the name of French fries — which, by some accounts, were actually invented in Belgium — to “freedom fries,” and French toast became “freedom toast.”
---
The U.S. pulled a similar move while at war with Germany during World War I: Sauerkraut’s German origins led Americans to rename the condiment “[liberty cabbage](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgcrxy&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com).” Other foods that we think of as classically American yet bear the names of German cities were also affected. The word “hamburger” comes from Hamburg, Germany, so during the Great War it was rechristened “liberty steak.” The seemingly all-American hot dog, meanwhile, was called a “frankfurter” at the time, and as the connection to Frankfurt, Germany, couldn’t stand, it was rebranded “liberty sausage.” (The term “hot dog” is also sneakily of German origin, as it comes from “dachshunds,” aka “little dogs.”) And speaking of dogs, in 1917, the American Kennel Club changed the official name of German shepherds to "shepherd dog," and in England the breed was renamed "Alsatian."

## Anti-German sentiment in WWI also caused several towns to change their names.
The anti-German sentiment of World War I went beyond food names; it led to paranoia and xenophobia that had a serious impact on German Americans at the time. In 1918, South Dakota banned speaking German on the phone, as well as in groups of three or more people. By the early 1920s, 34 states had passed English-only requirements in schools. Meanwhile, many small towns across the U.S. permanently changed their names as a result of the war. Garland, Nebraska, was known as Germantown until World War I, when the town decided to rename itself after a local soldier. Berlin, Iowa, became Lincoln in 1918. And East Germantown, Indiana, changed to Pershing in honor of General John J. Pershing, though some residents continue to use the original name.

A few years ago, members of the world's elite met at the annual World Economic Forum in Davos, Switzerland, and launched the Great Reset initiative.

What is their plan, and what does it mean for America?

In short, they aim to transform the world economy. As Klaus Schwab--the founder and executive director of the Forum--wrote, "We need a 'Great Reset' of capitalism." If successful, their plan would also have the effect of destroying our American way of life.

This initiative is not merely about economic reform. It is an attempt to impose global rule by so-called experts.

Some social media companies are censoring our efforts to promote a seminar we hosted on the Hillsdale campus that explored the topic of the Great Reset. Fortunately, we can communicate directly with you.

In this seminar, we...
* Consider the idea of the Great Reset and its implications for America.
* Explore how the ideology of "woke capitalism" is infiltrating large corporations.

We should be talking about the proposed bans on contraception.
We should be adding protections for federal civil service workers.
We should be safeguarding the EPA and other environmental regulations.
We should be staving off any efforts to dismantle Title I and the Department of Education.
We should be explaining that the recent SCOTUS decisions are not random; they are the result of years of strategizing and are a mere foreshadowing of things to come.
We should be telling the voters exactly what dangers are triggered in a Trump presidency through Project 2025.
Instead we are doing that thing that Democrats do, which is to analyze ad nauseum. This crisis du jour is the question of whether Biden is fit to stay on the ticket.
No comparable candidate exists.
Enough is enough.
Fourteen million Americans took time out of their day to go to the polls and cast a vote for Joe Biden in the Democratic Presidential Primary. I was one of them. I'll be pretty angry if they decide to set aside my vote because Joe underperformed in the 90 minute debate.
A grand total of[ 6 House Democrats have called for Biden to step aside](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/2eeed98c-6a77-4cf4-8215-d46e7acc6324?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). That's out of 213 total.
Why isn't the headline something like, "Here are the 207 House Democrats calling for Biden to stay in the race"? Or how 'bout this for a headline: "Reminder - We can't just Decide to Disenfranchise Voters, Willy-Nilly".
Meanwhile, every single syllable uttered by Joe Biden is re-played and [transcribed (sometimes inaccurately)](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/e56f3bba-b3cd-4730-965e-01212f077af5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for Lay-Z-Boy speech therapists and self-proclaimed neurologists to assess. If I were Joe Biden, I'd be in fetal position by now just from the unrelenting stares and squawks. For goodness sakes, have you ever watched how many times the MSNBC journalists stutter and splutter, and "uh...uh...uh..." some of them are literally half Joe Biden's age?
We haven't seen a comparable media frenzy since another Democrat - Hillary Clinton - had the audacity to collapse from pneumonia after she had been shredded in the press for her emails. Or was that before? The swarming swirling media muddles the memory.
If you must know the results of Biden's neurological exam, please [cast your gaze here](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/f6700025-dc2d-45b7-ba32-99e4f15e62c4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). It's amusing to me that the report is on the same landing page in which there is an Executive Order on prevention of access to personal data. Sorry Joe, I guess that right to privacy does not include the executive himself.
Yes, I am concerned about the President's age. But I'm more concerned about our party loyalties that give life to this movement to kick to the curb the most successful president in recent history, largely due to the 24/7 news cycle that is honed in on Joe Biden's cognitive health.
I dare any of the armchair politicians to run the executive office at the same time they are campaigning - not just for votes, but for favorable treatment in the press.
The [polls have settled down,](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/a4dbc13c-f387-48e2-ae6d-457240c43384?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) if they moved at all. Horrifying as it is, we are still within the margin of error of the convicted felon.
As for the debate, I'm not sure I could have kept my wits about me for 90 seconds in the same room with Donald Trump, much less for 90 minutes. Chances are pretty high that you couldn't have, either. Most of us lose all manner of reason just seeing Trump's image or hearing his voice on television.
Abraham Lincoln, addressing the Illinois State House in June of 1858, said "A house divided against itself cannot stand."
We can look across the Atlantic to our French allies to fully understand the importance of forming a united front against the far right extremists
The June 28, 2024 debate was 130 days from the November 5 election.
We have now lost 10 days and just as many sleepless nights on the question of whether Biden should drop out.
Enough is enough. We have an election to win. The divisions within the party are not helpful.
I'm supporting the Biden/Harris ticket with everything I've got. I hope you are too.
_If we haven 't met yet, I am Paula Collins, the Democratic and Working Families Party Candidate for New York's 21st Congressional District. Your comments are invaluable to me. Please let me hear from you. Remember that you can always visit my website at www.paulacollinsforcongress.com or by sending me a text at 315-230-3920. _

I'll never forget the day I borrowed my mother's fur coat to go undercover as a prostitute.

It was a sting operation and I was a plainclothes officer.

**My name 's Alison Esposito. After 25 years on the force, I retired from the NYPD to be Lee Zeldin's running mate when he ran for New York Governor in 2022. **

And we nearly pulled off the unthinkable in that race.

Since then, my life has taken a turn. I'm now running for Congress in one of the most closely watched races in the country. Many folks are saying whatever happens here will determine who controls the House Majority this time next year.

It's a 50/50, as-close-as-it-gets, true toss-up race in New York.

Why? Because the Radical Left Democrats are unloading 16 million dollars worth of attack ads in New York City ALONE. They have another 100+ million dollars ready to unleash at the drop of a hat. **That is enough cash to wipe out every vulnerable Conservative in every key state - including me!**

The debate between Presidents Biden and Trump has dramatically altered the political landscape.

One thing is certain though: _Our country faces a grave crisis in leadership._
It wasn’t just the two men on the stage who were arguing at a third-grade level. Our national politics has descended to that level too.
It wasn’t just me they tried to keep off the debate stage ... [it was all the issues](https://www.kennedy24.com/what-happened-real-debate-donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=cleaning_up_7_9_24_rs_nd1&n=5) that the leaders of [both parties are helpless to address](https://www.kennedy24.com/what-happened-real-debate-donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=cleaning_up_7_9_24_rs_nd1&n=6) and would therefore rather ignore.

At last count MORE THAN 10 MILLION PEOPLE watched my livestreamed debate performance. I answered the same questions as the other two, in real time. And I brought onto the stage with me THE ISSUES we really need to be talking about.
The corruption in Washington which thrived under both Presidents Biden and Trump.
The widening wealth gap.
The endless wars.
The chronic disease epidemic.
The assault on our rights and freedoms.
The destruction of the middle class.
Those are the issues I’ll address when I make it to Washington, D.C.
This debate has opened a wide door for my candidacy. Millions of voters are repulsed by the choice the Democrats and Republicans put on embarrassing display the week before last.

body:
Between A Rock and A Hard Place | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/497e4bef368c/conforti-for-congress-9916636?e=25f4fa3311)
---
| | |
---
| | | Dear Peter,

There is an old saying, "Don't be so smart that you are dumb."

This is a perfect depiction of the situation the Dems find themselves in with the Joe Biden 2024 candidacy. Their strict devotion to Identity Politics leaves them with little choice. For a number of reasons, Kamala Harris is now the likely successor to Biden should he step down. Can you imagine a President Harris??

Even though he staunchly claims he will stay in the race, the mounting pressure to step down may prove to be too much for him. Some reports are saying that Friday is a pivotal day. If he remains on the ticket after Friday, he will most likely be the 2024 Dem candidate in November, according to some political pundits.

Photo Credit: Getty Images

Either way, the Democrat Party's well-laid plans have failed, and they find themselves in uncharted territory - disarray. Sean Casten remains silent on this. He has aligned with Joe Biden repeatedly on all Democrat policies. Now, he is trying to distance himself.

One thing remains certain. Democrat policies have hurt the American people. People are worse off today, having to live on their savings and credit cards for everyday expenses. Sean Casten's support of these policies have hurt those that live in District 6. He is more concerned with his best interests than those he represents.

The only way to fix this is to change who is in office. It is time we elect people to represent us that will work for the benefit of the people of the 6th District - and for all Americans. It's time for our kind of change!!

Help elect Niki Conforti for U.S. Congressional District 6! When I am in Congress, I will push policies that benefit the people of D6 by acting to control the spending and advancing energy independence.

You can help. Please consider making a donation to the campaign. Your contribution will go a long way in helping us win! Click the link below to make a donation today.

[](https://conforti4congress.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7fd34b7284bf7f5e87a4e45e5&id=5fee9058ef&e=25f4fa3311)

Your support is greatly appreciated.
---
| Thank you,

Niki Conforti
Candidate
Illinois 6th Congressional District

body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1629%2E135344%2EjvtI9Z)

[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-july24.5Fk0a0&refcode=em240709-1&t=2&akid=1629%2E135344%2EjvtI9Z)
---
Hey there. It’s Adam Schiff. You might know me as the lead prosecutor in Trump’s first impeachment trial, or from my service on the January 6th Committee.
Unless you are part of MAGA world, in which case you may recognize me from Trump’s frequent attacks and name calling. He likes to refer to me as “sleazebag,” “shifty,” or more recently, “one of the true lowlifes in the history of politics in America.” He apparently doesn’t like me very much.
It’s now the same way Trump is going after my friend in Congress, Elissa Slotkin. She may not have the long list of nicknames I have, but he recently called her a "Far Left Liberal Lunatic," so she's on her way.
Republicans go after people like Elissa because they know she is smart, effective, knowledgeable and tough.
If they weren't concerned about Elissa, they'd ignore her. But Trump and all Republicans know that there is no winning the Senate, and there is no winning the White House without Michigan.
So they will attack and attack and attack her relentlessly. Just like they attack me.
I am writing to you today because if we all have Elissa's back, she's going to win her race. But it will take a team. So I am asking:
[**Can I count on you to make a contribution to Elissa Slotkin's campaign for Senate in Michigan? Her average online donation is around $30. Some give more. Some give less. All that matters is that she gets lots and lots of donations today.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-july24.5Fk0a0&refcode=em240709-1&t=3&akid=1629%2E135344%2EjvtI9Z)
We all have a role in defending our democracy and hard-won freedoms. Thanks for supporting Elissa Slotkin today.
Adam Schiff

East Lansing, MI 48826

body:
Your daily rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans.

**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hey friends!
ICYMI, Gov. Jared Polis is getting some heat on [Twitter/X](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) today for using the platform to tweet about how his "intelligent (130+ IQ) friends" don't use Twitter/X. In my opinion, he's just showing who he really is -- pompous, arrogant, and out of touch. If he's so smart, why doesn't he ditch the platform for good?
This is the Mountain Minute for Tuesday, July 9, 2024.
- Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
| | **TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
---
**[Biden to Hill Dems:'I am firmly committed to staying in this race,' ignoring growing calls to end bid](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [POLITICO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
President Joe Biden is attempting to head off more intraparty calls for him to drop out of the race, sending a letter to Hill Democrats Monday morning that emphatically stated he would continue on as the party's planned nominee.
"I am firmly committed to staying in this race, to running this race to the end, and to beating Donald Trump," he said in the letter to lawmakers.
Not even 24 hours before, four senior Democrats said on a private call with House party leadership that Biden should step aside. With Congress returning from the July Fourth recess Monday, Biden and his campaign have scrambled to tamp down lawmakers' concerns about his viability as a candidate after his widely-panned debate performance.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Too close to call: Automatic recount likely in House District 58 GOP primary](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [DENVER GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The Colorado Secretary of State is likely to order a recount for the House District 58 Republican Primary because of the narrow margin of just three votes, or 0.046%, between Larry Don Suckla and J. Mark Roeber.
* Under Colorado law, a mandatory recount is triggered if the margin between the top two candidates is 0.5% or less of the leading candidate's total votes; in this case, the threshold was met with 12,971 votes cast. As of the last update, Roeber had 6,484 votes (49.99%) and Suckla had 6,487 votes (50.01%).
* Let Colorado Vote Action, a super-PAC, contributed nearly $1 million to support Roeber a week before the primary.
* The winner of this recount will challenge Democratic candidate Kathleen Curry in the November election for the seat currently held by Rep. Marc Catlin, who is running for state Senate in District 5.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[U.S. home prices just hit another all-time high, Redfin report show](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [FOX BUSINESS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The U.S. median home sale price hit a record $397,954 in June, with a 5% year-over-year increase. The monthly mortgage payment now stands at $2,749 because of a median 30-year mortgage rate of 6.86%.
* High home prices and mortgage rates are affecting affordability, potentially slowing down home sales as buyers wait for rates to drop.
* Contributing factors to the housing crisis include chronic underbuilding, escalating mortgage rates, and sellers holding onto low-rate properties. With mortgage rates expected to stay high through 2024 and home supply remaining 34.3% below pre-pandemic levels, the market faces ongoing challenges.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Platte River to break ground on largest solar project in Northern Colorado](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [BIZ WEST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The Platte River Power Authority will break ground on the Black Hollow Solar project next week, aiming to power over 36,000 homes annually with approximately 367,000 megawatt-hours of energy by 2025.
* The project experienced a three-year delay due to the pandemic, tariffs, and other challenges but represents a significant step in the authority's shift toward non-carbon energy sources.
* This initiative is part of Platte River's broader strategy to diversify its energy resources, including the addition of other solar projects like Rawhide Prairie and Rawhide Flats, aligning with their 2018 Resource Diversification Policy to transition away from coal by the end of 2029.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Krannawitter: The constant in life is Joe Biden and he's not going anywhere](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [LIBERTY LYCEUM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), COMMENTARY
_Barring some catastrophic medical or other emergency, Joe Biden won 't be stepping down before the November general election. Even if he experiences some debilitating medical crisis--such as a paralyzing stroke--he might still not step down._
_Jill Biden shows many signs of being another Edith Wilson. If Edith Wilson --wife of President Woodrow Wilson--could conceal her husband's stroke and control what information the President received and who was permitted to see him, why can't Jill Biden?_
_There is, after all, a long tradition of Democratic wives married to Presidents lying about and actively covering up big problems with their husbands._
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Wood: Gov. Polis' 'Roadmap 2.0' is not economically sustainable, equitable, environmentally balanced or fact-based](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), COMMENTARY
_This past February, Gov. Jared Polis introduced his "Roadmap 2.0" that aims to cut greenhouse gas emissions in half by 2030 and achieve net-zero emissions in Colorado by 2050._
_The governor said, "Colorado has been a national model in bold climate action that improves air quality and protects our precious resources and open spaces. This updated, comprehensive Roadmap continues pushing our state forward in ways that will save Coloradans money, protect our air, and water, and ensure a more sustainable future for Colorado."_
_Gov. Polis has doubled down on this policy that drives many local climate action plans that subsequently drive bureaucracies and mandates that make housing, transportation and the general cost of living more expensive._

#
Friend of Life,

My name is Jesse. It's wonderful to meet you!

You've never received an email from me before. I don't work for Live Action, but I consider myself a part of Live Action's community of Life Defenders who are working to end abortion 365 days a year.

Sometimes when I think about the issue of abortion, it seems daunting. But when I realize that if I have the power to save _just one life_ , I know _I am_ making a difference.

If I, as a pro-life person, don't step up to rescue these innocent children, who will?

That's why I joined as a Live Action Life Defender in 2015 to help end abortion in my lifetime and build a culture of life. I am hoping you will join me in this critical work. **Your gift of just $50 is enough to change thousands of minds on abortion.**

We, as pro-life people, are the answer. This is the most pressing human rights issue of our day. We can't wait for someone else. It's up to us to live out the pro-life message every day.

When my mother conceived me, she was single. My father made the "simple" offer to pay for the abortion.

My mother, however, embraced life -- which not only gave me a chance to live but also the seven children that I am blessed to be the father of. Once I became a dad, **I knew I wanted to be the best father that I could be. **

Even though it wasn't easy for my mother to move ahead alone, she pushed through those early difficult times, and I guarantee you that she never once imagined how many lives would come through the one she decided to keep. I am thankful for her resolve.

My mom motivates me to continue fighting for the least of these, our most defenseless children.

Every month as I see my donation go through, I know that I am rescuing innocent children from abortion and transforming our society. And I know I'm not only fighting for these children, but their children's children, and for their mothers and families who would be broken abortion. We cannot overvalue the impact of a single life saved.

Imagine the lives we will save together if you join our team of Life Defenders!

Start your impact to save lives now: **[https://give.liveaction.org/your-gift-will-save-lives-from-abortion/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=a2e3e2c4e5774cd1ae822fb2627db1fb&_e=IsN_B4qRzuwhU0SAVdZ0K4dAHB04_WtI7DOMx2uwqOxDJFpQZ4peIJ9Lj9Qgo1PNWKsuWrwhcRyOOlS2Bq08xmaJnIXHfl2KYofMm20k2tKAdlewvPwhjWDYhsS4Be2UYl3lrXww_CVvxU48IRv5hlHK0t-QKNns95mw44WskbnMnIlKlpIO29ZJY5owcpFcew9IboTkctFmsZaLxsg4Y88baR1foRO6SQYX1BBs_mledi_rK4nDmxhEm_AmMD0xPmFl07cBC0-Xqyb4hxZBBAUx8l9DCGLKlh47ggvA_aKFGX1AHX7SSAJ0ulVP-JW6MfbkHVkh82_HAHFAiLdB8MAsCWfw5K9D42BhU7EEAhMjkSs9kRPcG91P9UIVPHwEUZsLlhL0-TxiZoSYHVbJXn66li5wJPogxQHd9aiGEZA%3D)**

Join me in bringing an end to abortion and building a culture that truly embraces every human life.

Sincerely,

Jesse
Live Action Life Defender since 2015

| Peter, **The assault on President Trump has reached a new low in New Jersey, threatening not just an icon of American excellence but the very livelihoods of hundreds of our fellow citizens.** The decision not to renew the liquor licenses for Trump National Golf Club Colts Neck and Trump National Golf Club Bedminster is an alarming escalation of political persecution, an affront to our liberties, and an economic blunder.
**What's really at stake?** These licenses are more than permits to serve beverages—they are a vital part of the economic framework of New Jersey, supporting hundreds of jobs and pouring millions into our state's economy. **The targeted attack on these establishments is an undeniable indicator of the left's disdain not just for a formidable political figure but for the ordinary New Jerseyans whose livelihoods depend on these establishments.**
---
|
---
It is crucial to underline that President Trump does not directly hold these liquor licenses, nor does he operate these businesses. The licenses in question support hundreds of hardworking New Jersey residents—bartenders, servers, and event coordinators—who face uncertainty because of this political vendetta.
---

The more likely explanation is that Himes has known Biden's condition for a long time but has remained silent and has supported and voted for every bad aspect of the Biden agenda.
_**Now realizing that he has been sailing on a sinking ship that was broken from the beginning has Himes finally decided to jump ship. The reason is obvious he is concerned that Connecticut voters will link him to Biden and he will be defeated at the polls.**_
**It is my intention, with your support to win the Republican Congressional Primary on August 13 and go on to defeat Himes in November.**
**With your support we can erase the bad policies of the Biden Administration and remove his enablers and supporters from office. It is time for Biden/Himes Dynasty to come to its natural conclusion.**

**2024 REPUBLICAN PARTY PLATFORM –** Yesterday, the RNC Platform Committee adopted President Donald J. Trump’s 2024 Republican Party Platform with overwhelming support– a pro-American agenda that stands in stark contrast to the record of weakness, failure, and dishonesty created by Joe Biden.

1. SEAL THE BORDER, AND STOP THE MIGRANT INVASION
2. CARRY OUT THE LARGEST DEPORTATION OPERATION IN AMERICAN HISTORY
3. END INFLATION, AND MAKE AMERICA AFFORDABLE AGAIN
4. MAKE AMERICA THE DOMINANT ENERGY PRODUCER IN THE WORLD, BY FAR!
5. STOP OUTSOURCING, AND TURN THE UNITED STATES INTO A MANUFACTURING SUPERPOWER
6. LARGE TAX CUTS FOR WORKERS, AND NO TAX ON TIPS!
7. DEFEND OUR CONSTITUTION, OUR BILL OF RIGHTS, AND OUR FUNDAMENTAL FREEDOMS, INCLUDING FREEDOM OF SPEECH, FREEDOM OF RELIGION, AND THE RIGHT TO KEEP AND BEAR ARMS
8. PREVENT WORLD WAR THREE, RESTORE PEACE IN EUROPE AND IN THE MIDDLE EAST, AND BUILD A GREAT IRON DOME MISSILE DEFENSE SHIELD OVER OUR ENTIRE COUNTRY -- ALL MADE IN AMERICA
9. END THE WEAPONIZATION OF GOVERNMENT AGAINST THE AMERICAN PEOPLE
10. STOP THE MIGRANT CRIME EPIDEMIC, DEMOLISH THE FOREIGN DRUG CARTELS, CRUSH GANG VIOLENCE, AND LOCK UP VIOLENT OFFENDERS
11. REBUILD OUR CITIES, INCLUDING WASHINGTON DC, MAKING THEM SAFE, CLEAN, AND BEAUTIFUL AGAIN.
12. STRENGTHEN AND MODERNIZE OUR MILITARY, MAKING IT, WITHOUT QUESTION, THE STRONGEST AND MOST POWERFUL IN THE WORLD
13. KEEP THE U.S. DOLLAR AS THE WORLD’S RESERVE CURRENCY
14. FIGHT FOR AND PROTECT SOCIAL SECURITY AND MEDICARE WITH NO CUTS, INCLUDING NO CHANGES TO THE RETIREMENT AGE

17. KEEP MEN OUT OF WOMEN’S SPORTS
18. DEPORT PRO-HAMAS RADICALS AND MAKE OUR COLLEGE CAMPUSES SAFE AND PATRIOTIC AGAIN
19. SECURE OUR ELECTIONS, INCLUDING SAME DAY VOTING, VOTER IDENTIFICATION, PAPER BALLOTS, AND PROOF OF CITIZENSHIP
20. UNITE OUR COUNTRY BY BRINGING IT TO NEW AND RECORD LEVELS OF SUCCESS

Michael Cloud (R-TX) and Sen. J.D. Vance (R-OH) introduced a bill to eliminate diversity, equity, and inclusion programs in the federal government. The wide-ranging Dismantle DEI Act was co-sponsored by 20 other Republicans in Congress. If passed, it would not only eliminate DEI programs in the federal government but also would rescind executive orders based around DEI from President Joe Biden, end DEI training, outlaw mandatory employee DEI pledges, prevent the awarding of federal contracts to entities that employ DEI practices, and prevent educational accreditation agencies from leveraging their position to push DEI policies in education institutions, among other measures. "I'm proud to introduce this legislation, which would root out DEI from our federal bureaucracy by eliminating such programs and stripping funding for DEI policies anywhere it exists. clean_body: | Senator JD Vance continues to fight for the People of Ohio in Washington, DC. Check out what he's been up to lately! ' THE CONTRAST MATTERS HERE -- IT'S NOT JUST THAT JOE BIDEN HAD A DISASTROUS PERFORMANCE, DONALD TRUMP DID EXTREMELY WELL' () - Senator Vance joined Jesse Watters to discuss the presidential debate. ' FAMILIES DESERVE TO UNDERSTAND THE LONG-TERM HEALTH IMPLICATIONS. THIS LEGISLATION WILL EMPOWER TRUSTED AND RESPECTED RESEARCH INSTITUTIONS TO GIVE RESIDENTS THE ANSWERS THEY DESERVE' () -- East Palestine residents are a step closer to federal funds that would create a long-term study on the health impacts of the Norfolk Southern train derailment that happened nearly 16 months ago. The East Palestine Health Impact Monitoring Act recently passed the Senate Committee on Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions with bipartisan support. "Families in East Palestine deserve to understand the long-term health implications of the Norfolk Southern train derailment," U.S. Sen. J.D. Vance said. "This legislation will empower trusted and respected research institutions to give residents the answers they deserve. I'm thankful we had an overwhelming, bipartisan vote to pass it through committee and that it's been introduced by our colleagues in the House of Representatives. There's more work to be done but passing this bill would be a big step in the right direction." ' THE FINDINGS SHARED BY [THE NTSB] CONFIRM MANY OF MY WORST FEARS' () -- "The derailment and subsequent chemical explosion were preventable tragedies resulting from a series of errors made by Norfolk Southern and its contractors," said Vance. ' THE DEI AGENDA IS A DESTRUCTIVE IDEOLOGY THAT BREEDS HATRED AND RACIAL DIVISION' () -- Rep. Michael Cloud (R-TX) and Sen. J.D. Vance (R-OH) introduced a bill to eliminate diversity, equity, and inclusion programs in the federal government. The wide-ranging Dismantle DEI Act was co-sponsored by 20 other Republicans in Congress. If passed, it would not only eliminate DEI programs in the federal government but also would rescind executive orders based around DEI from President Joe Biden, end DEI training, outlaw mandatory employee DEI pledges, prevent the awarding of federal contracts to entities that employ DEI practices, and prevent educational accreditation agencies from leveraging their position to push DEI policies in education institutions, among other measures. "The DEI agenda is a destructive ideology that breeds hatred and racial division," Vance said. "I'm proud to introduce this legislation, which would root out DEI from our federal bureaucracy by eliminating such programs and stripping funding for DEI policies anywhere it exists. Americans' tax dollars should not be co-opted to spread this radical and divisive ideology -- this bill would ensure they are not." ' THE WAY THAT OUR FEDERAL GOVERNMENT HAS INTERPRETED THIS IS TO EXPLICITLY ALLOW RACIST DECISION-MAKING, PRIMARILY TARGETING WHITE AND ASIAN AMERICANS' () -- Joe Biden likely won't sign it, but regardless, Sen. J.D. Vance (R-Ohio) has introduced legislation to dismantle all federal DEI programs. "If you want to root out the Deep State and the bureaucracy, you need political appointees who are aligned with the agenda. And what this legislation does -- I'm not an idiot, Joe Biden's not going to sign it -- but Donald Trump would," Vance tells Glenn Beck, adding, "What it would do is really destroy the diversity, equity, and inclusion bureaucracy that exists in our country." One example Vance uses is of a farm program that explicitly excluded white Americans from the provision of farm assistance for American farmers. "That's ridiculous," Vances tells Glenn. "You can't discriminate, whether black or white, against people on the basis of skin color, this would proactively root this stuff out of our government, and it's a very important first step to getting basic merit back in our federal system." ' DEMOCRATS HAVE DOUBLED DOWN ON THIS IDEA THAT IF YOU WANT A BORDER, IF YOU DON'T THINK YOU SHOULD HAVE 20 MILLION ILLEGAL ALIENS IN THIS COUNTRY, THEN YOU'RE A RACIST' () -- President Joe Biden's migration burdens citizens' public safety, hospitals, schools, and housing, Sen. J.D. Vance (R-OH) told Breitbart News in an exclusive interview. Vance is warning that Biden's border crisis and his flood of millions of unvetted illegal aliens have farther-reaching consequences than most people imagine. Vance argued that Democrats' strategy of attacking Americans who are worried about the tidal wave of migrants is a key reason many working middle-class voters are turning toward former President Donald Trump. "The thing that the Democrats have really doubled down on is this idea that if you want a border, if you don't think you should have 20 million illegal aliens in this country, then you're a racist," Vance told Breitbart News. "People just don't buy it. They're sick of being called dirty names because they just want to live in a safe and stable community." ' WE NEED TO FIGHT BACK AGAINST THE WEAPONIZATION OF GOVERNMENT AGAINST POLITICAL OPPOSITION' () -- A group of Senate Republicans has pledged to block the fast-tracking of President Joe Biden's judicial nominees in response to the Biden administration's "persecution" of former President Donald Trump. The group, led by Sen. J.D. Vance (R-OH), also includes Sens. Mike Lee (R-UT), Bill Hagerty (R-TN), Roger Marshall (R-KS), Tommy Tuberville (R-AL), and Eric Schmitt (R-MO). "We need to fight back against the weaponization of government against political opposition. I'm proud to stand with a number of my Republican senate colleagues and do just that," Vance said. ' WE DID NOT FIGHT FOR THIS COUNTRY THAT WE LOVE SO THAT JOE BIDEN COULD THROW HIS CHIEF POLITICAL RIVAL IN JAIL' () -- Regular people are saying "enough is enough" after a Manhattan jury found former President Donald Trump guilty on all 34 counts in his business records trial, Sen. J.D. Vance (R-OH) said during an appearance on Breitbart News Saturday. "We come from a family of military service, as I'm sure a lot of your listeners -- people who served in Vietnam and Korea and World War II. Our relatives and ourselves, we did not fight for this country that we love so that Joe Biden could throw his chief political rival in jail," Vance explained. "But the whole idea of America is yeah, we have some intense debates from time to time. We fight with one another and we argue with one another. But at the end of the day, you try to persuade the American voter. You don't try to throw your rivals in prison. ... That is Banana Republic. That is the reason why we fight wars -- to prevent from becoming the very thing that Joe Biden is trying to do to this country," Vance said. ' OUR TAX DOLLARS SHOULD NOT BE SUPPORTING DIRECT ATTACKS ON U.S. PERSONS BASED UPON REASONABLE POLITICAL DISAGREEMENT' () -- Ohio Republican Sen. J.D. Vance and Florida Republican Rep. Matt Gaetz are demanding answers from Secretary of State Antony Blinken surrounding a State Department-linked Ukrainian nongovernmental organization (NGO) that published a list of Americans labeled "Trumpists and Communists" for their opposition to providing more U.S. funds to Ukraine. "Needless to say, whatever one thinks of American foreign aid or support for Ukraine, all Americans can agree that our tax dollars should not be supporting direct attacks on U.S. persons based upon reasonable political disagreement, and especially not direct attacks on U.S. legislators based solely upon their vote," they wrote. name: Lucas Tyree Kunce
subject: Nearly two years ago, Josh Hawley failed veterans like me.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Lucas Kunce for Missouri
body:
I want to tell you about the burn pit I lived next to in Iraq — and what happened when I got home.
#
Peter — nearly two years ago, Josh Hawley and 40 other Republicans blocked a bill to expand healthcare to millions of veterans like me who were exposed to toxic burn pits during their service.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/55546?refcode=em20240709-5964&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=5964%2E614464%2EgEj9fb)
In a moment, I’m going to ask you to **[make your first donation of any amount toward my grassroots campaign to replace Hawley in the U.S. Senate.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/55546?refcode=em20240709-5964&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=5964%2E614464%2EgEj9fb) But first, I want to tell you about the burn pit I lived next to in Iraq — and how politicians like him failed veterans like me.**
**[ADD A DONATION NOW »](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/55546?refcode=em20240709-5964&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=5964%2E614464%2EgEj9fb)**
It was 2009. I was stationed at the Al Taqaddum Airbase where I was a Marine Captain leading a police training team. Twelve Marines and a Navy Corpsman. Running missions through Habbaniyah, Fallujah, and Ramadi.
It was my first of three tours of duty during the War on Terror. And from our camp, the base’s burn pit loomed over us.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/55546?refcode=em20240709-5964&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=5964%2E614464%2EgEj9fb)
Smoke columns filled the sky and blew through our living space. We ran through it, joking about how we should be doing gas mask runs. For three months that pit bathed us in toxic fumes. We accepted it and focused on our duty.
For me, that was planning our routes and poring over intel to avoid the immediate danger: IEDs on all the convoys and missions we were running outside the wire. I was so proud to bring every member of that team home safely.
**Or so I thought — because, as it turns out, we couldn’t protect ourselves from our own country.**
When I got back from Iraq, I developed a persistent tickle in my throat. Constant irritation. I never had allergies before and annoyed myself with the constant throat clearing. Eventually, I was so embarrassed by it that I went to the base clinic. They said it was postnasal drip and that they could give me allergy medicine. There was no formal diagnosis. But over 10 years later, it’s still there.
Bothersome. Uncomfortable, but certainly manageable. And that’s about the best story you’ll hear about a vet who’s been exposed to burn pits. Many struggle with chronic respiratory issues. Migraines. Cancer.
So imagine how we all felt, watching all these Republicans like Josh Hawley, most of whom have never even worn the uniform, throw us a giant middle finger?
I know that’s harsh language, but it has to be. Because what they did was about as anti-American as it gets. Patriots don’t attack veterans who suffered injuries or illness from being around those toxic pits.
Many of these same Republicans spent years voting to keep us in these forever wars, lying to the American people about what was really going on over there, and getting rich off their defense contractor stocks that skyrocket when we’re at war.
These people profited off of sending us over there only to screw us when we came back messed up. **It’s criminal — and I’m ready to do something about it.**
I served my country for 13 years in the United States Marine Corps. I’d give anything for this country — and that’s exactly why I’m running to replace Josh Hawley in the U.S. Senate.
**We deserve leaders who are willing to make even an ounce of the sacrifice our veterans have.[If you’re with me, please add a donation of $10 or anything at all to my grassroots campaign today so we can stay on track with our goals this month, get this message in front of Missouri voters, and defeat Josh Hawley this November.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/55546?refcode=em20240709-5964&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=5964%2E614464%2EgEj9fb)**
