[Contribute $10](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/55547?refcode=em20240709-5964&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=6&akid=5964%2E614464%2EgEj9fb) [Contribute $25](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/55547?refcode=em20240709-5964&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=7&akid=5964%2E614464%2EgEj9fb) [Contribute $30](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/55547?refcode=em20240709-5964&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=30&t=8&akid=5964%2E614464%2EgEj9fb) [Contribute $50](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/55547?refcode=em20240709-5964&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=50&t=9&akid=5964%2E614464%2EgEj9fb) [Contribute $100](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/55547?refcode=em20240709-5964&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=100&t=10&akid=5964%2E614464%2EgEj9fb) [Contribute $250](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/55547?refcode=em20240709-5964&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=250&t=11&akid=5964%2E614464%2EgEj9fb) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/55546?refcode=em20240709-5964&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=12&akid=5964%2E614464%2EgEj9fb)

Colorado is implementing a new law that requires credit card companies to track sales at gun stores with a distinct merchant category code.
#

Friend -
**Next month, Colorado will begin to implement a new law that requires credit card companies to use a distinct merchant category code for gun stores, which can help track suspicious sales.**
We’re glad that Colorado has taken this important action. Both California and New York have also taken actions to implement these distinct merchant category codes for gun stores. Now, it’s time for other states to follow suit.
[**Will you please chip in $3 today to help us keep advocating for states to allow credit card companies to flag suspicious gun and ammunition purchases in every state across our nation?**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-july24.-nTEO4&refcode=em240709-1-30&t=1&akid=8464%2E3935704%2EFssbZ9)
**[DONATE](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-july24.-nTEO4&refcode=em240709-1-30&t=2&akid=8464%2E3935704%2EFssbZ9)**
In 2017, the deadliest mass shooting in modern American history took place in Las Vegas, Nevada. Sixty people were killed, and hundreds more were injured.
What you may not know is that over the course of 12 months prior to the shooting, the perpetrator of the Las Vegas massacre charged $94,000 worth of guns and ammunition used in that mass shooting to his credit cards.
If credit card companies were able to monitor suspicious gun and ammunition purchases, it could truly save lives and prevent the next devastating mass shooting from happening. Colorado has taken a crucial step in keeping its residents safe. New York and California have taken this step as well. Now we must keep up our work to ensure other states can work with credit card companies to implement merchant category codes for gun store purchases.
[**Please, will you chip in $3 to GIFFORDS PAC today to help give credit card companies the tools to flag suspicious gun purchases and prevent tragedies before they happen?**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-july24.-nTEO4&refcode=em240709-1-30&t=3&akid=8464%2E3935704%2EFssbZ9)

Now, it’s time for other states to follow suit. In 2017, the deadliest mass shooting in modern American history took place in Las Vegas, Nevada. Sixty people were killed, and hundreds more were injured. What you may not know is that over the course of 12 months prior to the shooting, the perpetrator of the Las Vegas massacre charged $94,000 worth of guns and ammunition used in that mass shooting to his credit cards. If credit card companies were able to monitor suspicious gun and ammunition purchases, it could truly save lives and prevent the next devastating mass shooting from happening. Colorado has taken a crucial step in keeping its residents safe. New York and California have taken this step as well. Now we must keep up our work to ensure other states can work with credit card companies to implement merchant category codes for gun store purchases. Does Mary Peltola Think Her Post is as 'Irrelevant' as Her Opinion?

ANCHORAGE, AK - Mary Peltola announced yesterday that she will be
forgoing her duties as our congresswoman to go fishing.

As Alaska's sole member of Congress, this will leave the state with no
voice in the U.S. House as critical votes are brought this week.

Her announcement came just days after she said her opinion on Joe
Biden's fitness to run for president is "irrelevant."
<https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=69900&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC
3-A904-E168017696C1&u=62642>

It begs the question: does Mary Peltola think her post as Alaska's sole
congressional representative is as "irrelevant" as her opinion on Joe
Biden's ability to serve as commander-in-chief?

"Every Alaskan should be asking why Mary Peltola is not in Washington
representing us like she signed up to do. Her comments and her actions
are embarrassing and hurting our state," Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom
said in a statement. "It's clear that Mary Peltola thinks her post is
as 'irrelevant' as her opinion on Joe Biden's ability to serve. Alaska
needs a congresswoman who will show up for work. We deserve better than
this."

body:

| | Hey there, Peter! It’s Angela Alsobrooks, the Democratic nominee for Senate here in Maryland. Over the next few months I’m going to be asking a lot of this team and I think it’s only fair I introduce myself and tell you a bit more about what got me into this race in the first place. But, if you don’t have time right now, just know how much I appreciate you opening this email and supporting my campaign. Every dollar and all of the energy you have given our campaign truly makes a difference. **[So, before I give you my backstory, would you be able to pitch in just $5 to give my campaign a boost this month?](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/28089?t=14&amount=5&akid=1972%2E52803%2EvG4kcv)** | | | [DONATE](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/28089?t=15&amount=5&akid=1972%2E52803%2EvG4kcv)
---
[](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/28089?t=16&amount=5&akid=1972%2E52803%2EvG4kcv)
This Senate campaign has me thinking back all the way to 1986, when I won my first-ever election for student government treasurer.
I was a freshman in high school then, and I set a goal: Become the student body president by senior year.
And I did it – because I chose not to waste my time dreaming about the next rung up on the ladder. What I did was dive into my role, find problems that needed solutions, and do the best job I possibly could. That was enough, and by my senior year, I was student body president!
[](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/28089?t=17&amount=5&akid=1972%2E52803%2EvG4kcv)
The next time I ran for office was when my daughter Alex was six. A friend of mine was visiting, and I told her I wouldn’t let Alex play in the yard unless I was keeping an eye on her. The neighborhood just didn’t feel safe.
She said, “Angela, unless you plan to change it, we shouldn’t have this discussion again.”
I decided to run for state’s attorney. With the love and support of my community, I was elected to my first term in 2010 and re-elected in 2014.
I repaid that support with action. Over two terms, my office implemented restorative justice policies that reduced crime rates, decreased recidivism, and helped former inmates build productive lives after release.
Together, we helped build the kind of community I wanted for Alex: A safe, peaceful place to live, work, and play.
[](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/28089?t=18&amount=5&akid=1972%2E52803%2EvG4kcv)
After eight years as a state's attorney, I understood the causes of crime well – but I didn’t have the tools to address the problems that led people to the courtroom in the first place. But the County Executive’s office did.
That’s when I jumped into my toughest race yet, and I’m so fortunate that this community showed up for me once again.
My administration shows up for the people of Prince George’s every day. We’ve incentivized business development, built a treatment center to address mental illness and addiction, expanded opportunities for students, and so much more.
[](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/28089?t=19&amount=5&akid=1972%2E52803%2EvG4kcv)
In May, I officially became the Democratic nominee for the U.S. Senate in Maryland!
Marylanders deserve practical, comprehensive policies to break down barriers today and help us thrive tomorrow. I learned what that takes as County Executive, and I’m committed to doing better and going farther in the U.S. Senate.
**I don’t want to keep you too long, so I just have one last request: Every campaign takes a village, and this one is absolutely no exception.[Can I count on you to chip in just $5 to our groundbreaking campaign for the U.S. Senate to build lasting progress for Maryland?](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/28089?t=20&amount=5&akid=1972%2E52803%2EvG4kcv)**
_If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately._

With love and gratitude,
Angela Alsobrooks

| Here are the key points:

1. Seal the border, and stop the migrant invasion.
2. Carry out the largest deportation operation in American history.
3. End inflation, and make America affordable again.
4. Make America the dominant energy producer in the world, by far!
5. Stop outsourcing, and turn the United States into a manufacturing superpower.
6. Large tax cuts for workers, and no tax on tips!
7. Defend our Constitution, our Bill of Rights, and our fundamental freedoms, including freedom of speech, freedom of religion, and the right to keep and bear arms.
8. Prevent World War Three, restore peace in Europe and in the Middle East, and build a great iron dome missile defense shield over our entire country -- all made in America.
9. End the weaponization of government against the American people.
10. Stop the migrant crime epidemic, demolish the foreign drug cartels, crush gang violence, and lock up violent offenders.
11. Rebuild our cities, including Washington DC, making them safe, clean, and beautiful again.
12. Strengthen and modernize our military, making it, without question, the strongest and most powerful in the world.
13. Keep the U.S. dollar as the world's reserve currency.
14. Fight for and protect Social Security and Medicare with no cuts, including no changes to the retirement age.
15. Cancel the electric vehicle mandate and cut costly and burdensome regulations.
16. Cut federal funding for any school pushing critical race theory, radical gender ideology, and other inappropriate racial, sexual, or political content on our children.
17. Keep men out of women's sports.
18. Deport pro-Hamas radicals and make our college campuses safe and patriotic again.
19. Secure our elections, including same-day voting, voter identification, paper ballots, and proof of citizenship.
20. Unite our country by bringing it to new and record levels of success.

body:
Our campaign has sent a lot of fundraising emails lately — more than I wish we had to send. So I wanted to take a moment to explain what these messages mean to our campaign, and why you're seeing more of them from us than usual. In just a few days, we close the books on an official FEC fundraising deadline for our campaign for Senate. Because of Michigan's early August primary, we're legally required to report our numbers from this reporting period, which ends July 17th. When it ends, we report how much money we've raised and those results will be looked at with a fine-tooth comb by the press, our opponents, and even potential allies. What we report is widely viewed as an indicator of our campaign's strength. The numbers have the ability to invite attacks if opponents think we are weak or encourage our allies to do more to help us win if they are strong. But the numbers we want to reach are also very real goals. They are numbers we need to reach in order to win. So when you see us rising in the polls, when you see our ads playing on TV, and when you see us WIN this race and hopefully hold the Senate, please know emails like this and the response to them are a huge part of how it happens. # Tuesday Motivation
### Be a Champion
| | | [Dan Carr](https://substack.com/@dancarr2014)
---
| Jul 9
---
| [](https://substack.com/@dancarr2014)
---
Hello Friend,
[](https://substack.com/redirect/665a2b8b-3de1-4d3b-b1a2-466e768aad77?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Being a champion is not just about winning or achieving great things--it's about the relentless pursuit of excellence and the refusal to give up, no matter how tough the journey gets. Every challenge we face is an opportunity to grow, to learn, and to become stronger. Champions are made in the moments when they choose to persevere, even when the odds seem insurmountable.
Remember, success is not a destination; it's a journey. It's the small, consistent efforts we put in every day that lead to big, extraordinary results. So, as we tackle our tasks and projects this week, let's keep a few key points in mind:
1. **Stay Positive:** Your attitude determines your altitude. A positive mindset can transform obstacles into opportunities.
2. **Embrace Challenges:** Each challenge is a stepping stone to greatness. Embrace them with courage and determination.
3. **Support Each Other:** We're in this together. Encourage and uplift your teammates. A strong team is unstoppable.
4. **Never Give Up:** Persistence is key. Keep pushing forward, even when it gets tough. Your efforts will pay off.

Wishing you all a fantastic and productive Tuesday!!

| | | Another Trump presidency would be a disaster for countless reasons, but one in particular isn’t being talked about enough: [Project 2025](https://default.salsalabs.org/T406aa583-8336-4c30-9c8e-ed70d10142f0/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) – the right-wing plan to upend our democracy and usher in authoritarianism. The ultra-conservative Heritage Foundation and many other Trump MAGA allies are behind Project 2025, and the plan, if Trump is elected president, includes:
* Making the president all powerful by gutting checks and balances
* Replacing thousands of longstanding government employees who are experts in their fields with MAGA-approved yes men and rubber stamps for Trump
* Bringing independent agencies like the Dept. of Justice under Trump’s control, so he can get revenge on his political enemies
* Downsizing or eliminating federal agencies like the Dept. of Education
* Cutting essential programs like Social Security, ripping away reproductive freedoms, and so much more.

Trump is trying to distance himself from this fascist playbook, claiming to know nothing about it – but that’s a lie. We need to do everything we can to prevent Project 2025 from infiltrating our government and destroying our democracy. body:
Read Coach’s guest op-ed on Yellowhammer. Link inside >>>
| | | Peter,

In 2017, President Trump led the charge to get the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act passed in Congress and signed into law. This was a huge win for our family farmers in Alabama and across America, who are facing massive headwinds now under the Biden economy.

This major overhaul doubled the death tax exemption from $5.5 million to $11 million.

While the left desperately and dishonestly wanted to spin this as a handout to the “rich” in our country, a predictable talking point in their class warfare nonsense, it was a lifeline to our nation’s struggling family farms – something the left knows NOTHING about.

**Now, Coach is helping lead the charge to pass the Death Tax Repeal Act authored by Senator John Thune to _eliminate the death tax 100%_ and ensure our farmers can continue feeding America and the world.**

You can read the full op-ed from Coach and President of the Alabama Farmers Federation and fifth-generation farmer Jimmy Parnell here:

[**https://yellowhammernews.com/sen-tuberville-jimmy-parnell-protect-family-farmers-by-repealing-the-death-tax/**](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/c8e2774da8d4d6d3c3d6b838967d376c/33013/4b79689e0172f13e3947229f28c3afba/479a9b062fca67dec3d6b838967d376c/33013)

Our nation has lost 140,000+ farms and 20 million acres of farm acres in recent years – while China has been on a massive spending spree to buy up prime farmland.

Farm families need relief and they need it NOW.

**We’re grateful for your support as we fight to** **MAKE AMERICA GREAT AGAIN! **

\- Team Tuberville

| | | I endured the gauntlet of West Point Military Academy, then boot camp, then became a Tank Platoon Leader in the final days of the Cold War.

I just got word that Joe Biden and the Democrats are _closer than they 've ever been before_ to destroying our Conservative House Majority once and for all. The latest reports show they've stockpiled over $100,000,000 to defeat us in enough swing states to bring forth a COMPLETE LIBERAL TAKEOVER.

The ONLY THING standing in the way of Joe Biden having full control - and ramming through any radical policy he wants - is just a few competitive House seats. That's it.

I don't tell you this lightly and I know that's not what you want to see happen to our country.

_**[That's why I'm rushing to you, in partnership with Majority Leader Steve Scalise, to raise a game-changing one million dollars in the next 72 hours.](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=30f6e529e5ea467bacad73b3d3bad717&_e=t2tp3Vyfk2AdHVlChOOAyfJPqyt1OOTnL3H4dZBnf7_ZAz_wbHMSV1RxCUVw0mmF7nX6bQrKDu_15gpQc5u6HW0VpJXITWyLPOE_u03HJ-PlIkoFVRJHzNOOVcgajhSdO1HeF3MGNBsie8lg-kwLj8pKqK8aDYkF-OAAVLdRVjUnmRYwMyCKJ8Ba4FT337AR5upbMo77q6-pO6ThNm4mEFLRgMR-UXCraBqAeWx713qLf5yZCkY8xHCIkbGe8t2jMoiQHp1X-U0a5pFlaQDY2Wc4JMNcC6hbOonsmPdLS4I0zDUrhOQn9MNBQY0hgrZOozRaGs9C8zJvv6yHmKR-vPGv23mbzRu5aV_Vt23LAOWE_FzpEz1-YaeUUvGePFfKz4dHOkkS-NsRkZmQGTJtk0Rx69bPFMRjFuCR5j4lwOVOqwCq2xrYzgYmBiqBfp_87nYWTL6nL67aWC7TzRGsqA%3D%3D "That’s why I’m rushing to you, in partnership with Majority Leader Steve Scalise, to raise a game-changing one million dollars in the next 72 hours.")**_ I know what you're thinking... that's not enough runway to raise that much. Friend,

It should be common sense for a Senator from a border state:

_**Border security is national security.**_

**New Mexico’s border is the most-wide open in the United States; we make the whole country vulnerable.**

_But far-left Democrats like Martin Heinrich don’t think so._ Millions of illegal immigrants are flooding across our southern border, and Joe Biden and Martin Heinrich’s policies encourage them to keep coming— not just from Mexico, but from Communist China, India, and Central America.

Project 2025 is a detailed, 900-page plan for the next Republican president of the United States. The Heritage Foundation (and its leader, Kevin Roberts) is the primary organization behind Project 2025. So when Roberts says the most recent Supreme Court decision is encouraging and shows **“In spite of all this nonsense from the left, we are going to win. We're in the process of taking this country back," you should pay attention.**

Friend, when I was serving as an Ohio state representative, I didn't spend much of my spare time hanging out with other legislators. Instead, I spent countless hours at United Steelworkers Local 169 in Mansfield, Ohio, the town where I grew up.
I would listen to workers who stopped at the hall before or after their shifts. I learned how they made steel, built cars, and generally, how hard they worked – most gladly accepted six-day workweeks because of the overtime pay. Their goal, like so many fighting to achieve the American dream, was to give their kids a better future.

**I thought often then, as I do now, about a lesson taught by the Rev. Dr. Martin Luther King Jr.: that all work has dignity, whether you punch a clock, swipe a badge, work for tips, are raising children or caring for an aging parent. **

Whatever their occupation, folks take pride in working. That's why, to this day, I'm fighting to uphold the Dignity of Work – but it's not a fight I can win alone. Friend, over the past 40 years, Ohioans and Americans have worked harder than ever, yet that hard work doesn’t pay off like it should. All while corporate profits and executive salaries are higher than ever.
**That's why I'm in this fight – and if you're with me, friend, I need your help. I'm facing my toughest reelection yet, and with _CNN_ analysts _ _ reporting that I'm one of the most vulnerable senators on the ballot, my seat is in serious jeopardy.**

If we lose in Ohio, the GOP could take back Senate control – giving them a mandate to pass more tax breaks for corporations and the ultra-rich and guarantee fewer rights for workers. Only together can we stop them.
**[So please, will you chip in $5 or more right now to win in Ohio, defend the Senate, and keep up the fight for the Dignity of Work?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88544808/484443930/-1893289703?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode2=064a5d5d-153e-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&refcode=jtk2155-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNjRhNWQ1ZC0xNTNlLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=mPgMA5jf2NLdSiAzTZbkCg6oSfFQFDoVQJmMZ8hnZ2I=)**

clean_body: I can't win this fight alone, friend. | | | = Friend, when I was serving as an Ohio state representative, I didn't spend much of my spare time hanging out with other legislators. Instead, I spent countless hours at United Steelworkers Local 169 in Mansfield, Ohio, the town where I grew up. I would listen to workers who stopped at the hall before or after their shifts. I learned how they made steel, built cars, and generally, how hard they worked – most gladly accepted six-day workweeks because of the overtime pay. Their goal, like so many fighting to achieve the American dream, was to give their kids a better future. I thought often then, as I do now, about a lesson taught by the Rev. Dr. Martin Luther King Jr.: that all work has dignity, whether you punch a clock, swipe a badge, work for tips, are raising children or caring for an aging parent. Whatever their occupation, folks take pride in working. That's why, to this day, I'm fighting to uphold the Dignity of Work – but it's not a fight I can win alone. = Friend, over the past 40 years, Ohioans and Americans have worked harder than ever, yet that hard work doesn’t pay off like it should. All while corporate profits and executive salaries are higher than ever. That's why I'm in this fight – and if you're with me, friend, I need your help. I'm facing my toughest reelection yet, and with CNN analysts reporting that I'm one of the most vulnerable senators on the ballot, my seat is in serious jeopardy. If we lose in Ohio, the GOP could take back Senate control – giving them a mandate to pass more tax breaks for corporations and the ultra-rich and guarantee fewer rights for workers. Only together can we stop them. = When you love this country, you fight for the people who make it work. I'll never forget the day I borrowed my mother's fur coat to go undercover as a prostitute.

It was a sting operation and I was a plainclothes officer.

**My name 's Alison Esposito. After 25 years on the force, I retired from the NYPD to be Lee Zeldin's running mate when he ran for New York Governor in 2022. **

And we nearly pulled off the unthinkable in that race.

Since then, my life has taken a turn. I'm now running for Congress in one of the most closely watched races in the country. Many folks are saying whatever happens here will determine who controls the House Majority this time next year.

subject: The good, the bad, and the ugly

body:
I need you to read this right now.
| | |
---
It’s James Carville. Read this right now.
**The good:** Jacky Rosen and her team launched new TV ads to get her message out to critical undecided voters as the general election heats up.
**The bad:** Jacky had to raise her online fundraising goals to afford these new ads. **Now, she has a $12,570 gap in her budget – and she needs to close it SOON, or else she’ll have to take her ads off the air.**

subject: Capitol & Campaign July Update #2
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY VOTE BOLICK
body:
| | | [ ](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=de7a3a1dcb&e=a7ab36849c)
---
| | Dear Freedom Fighters,

I wanted to take a break from the campaign trail to share a quick update. Okay, I’ll admit one of our a/c units needs to be serviced, so I am waiting for the service repair folks to arrive so I am afforded a few minutes to fill you in.

First, I hope you and your family had a safe, celebratory Independence Day last week celebrating our country's freedoms. Lately, I have been primarily focused on campaigning for my contested State Senate primary election, so I continue as the Republican candidate representing LD2 to take on the Democratic State Senate candidate come November. I have been afforded the opportunity to meet a lot of new supporters along the campaign trail. My new supporters approve of my acumen, pragmatism, common-sense leadership, and legislative track record like my long-time supporters do. Voters in District 2 overwhelmingly agree I am the most qualified candidate to continue representing them at the Capitol. As for my general election opponent, she has been serving in the House since she was elected in November 2020 and she hasn't had a single bill signed into law under either a Republican or Democratic governor. Fortunately, I have been successful getting legislation enacted under Governors Ducey and Hobbs.

_The endorsements keep rolling in_. I have benefited from many amazing primary [endorsements](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=100290be14&e=a7ab36849c), including
* Arizona Association of REALTORS
* Arizona Bike PAC
* Arizona Chamber of Commerce and Industry
* Arizona Fraternal Order of Police
* Arizona Free Enterprise Club
* Arizona Multihousing Association
* Arizona Nurses Association
* Arizona Police Association
* Former U.S. Congressman John Shadegg (released today)
* Former Phoenix City Councilman Sal DiCiccio
* Former State Senator Steve Kaiser
* Greater Phoenix Chamber
* Home Builders Association of Central Arizona
* National Rifle Association
* And a few MORE endorsements will be released this week!

Last week, my primary endorsement list grew to also include the local pro-active Tea Party [Arizona](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=89f0dde483&e=a7ab36849c) and Arizona’s Politics Uncorked [PAC](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=daea82e6ab&e=a7ab36849c).

On Sunday evening the Arizona Daily Independent published an opinion piece I wrote about my legislative record. You can read it [HERE](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=32172673e8&e=a7ab36849c).

_Voting Information for the Primary_

As you may know, last week, early voting began for Arizona’s July 30th primary election. If you are a registered voter on the active early voting list, your early ballots were mailed to you already. If you didn't receive it, you should contact your county recorder's office.

If you vote in person during early voting or on election day, [HERE](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=76e75d9d94&e=a7ab36849c) is a list of polling locations in Maricopa County.

If you live outside of Maricopa, check [HERE](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=54e245611d&e=a7ab36849c) for a list.

If you do vote by mail, please be sure to mail your mail-in ballot back so your ballot is cured and tabulated in a timely manner. If you spoil your ballot and you need a replacement early ballot, the last day to request a ballot by mail is July 19th. The local elections department suggests July 23rd is the last day to mail back your ballot. Remember: election day is on Tuesday, July 30th.

_Primary Election Guides_

If you are still deciding who is the best candidate to represent you for a particular office, you can use the CCEC voter [guide](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=4cdd805a39&e=a7ab36849c) to read what the candidate says in their own words. These guides were mailed to you at your registered address a few weeks ago.
If you are a values voter, you can refer to the [AZ Voter Guide](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=73d8e20175&e=a7ab36849c). If you are a Second Amendment supporter, you can check reference a candidate's voting [record](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=ab75ec28af&e=a7ab36849c) with Arizona Citizens Defense League, or to see if the National Rifle Association has endorsed him or her [HERE](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=6cc48856db&e=a7ab36849c).

_Upcoming Fundraiser_

Next week, we have a campaign fundraiser scheduled on Wednesday, July 17th from 4pm to 5:30pm in downtown Phoenix. Please RSVP to [info@bolickforarizona.com](mailto:info@bolickforarizona.com) for the address. If you cannot attend, but you’d like to donate, please visit my [website](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=bd6c4200e2&e=a7ab36849c) to do so. I appreciate your backing very much!

_Legislator-related Update_

A few weeks ago, I signed onto the Only Citizen Voters Coalition’s [letter](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=050671bae7&e=a7ab36849c) in support of SAVE Act along with over 500 state legislators from around the country. The SAVE Act sponsored by Congressman Chip Roy (R-TX) and Senator Mike Lee (R-UT) will be considered and debated in the US House sometime this week. This commonsense bill would close loopholes to prevent non-citizens from voting in our elections. Contact your US Congressman and US Senators today to request they sponsor and vote for the SAVE Act.

Last week, I signed on to an amicus in _Parents Protecting our Children v Eau Claire Area School District, Wisconsin_. Essentially, the amici brief is asking the US Supreme Court to grant cert so that parents won't continue to be barred from court until their children are damaged. The question presented: When a school district adopts an explicit policy to usurp parental decision-making authority over a major health-related decision—and to conceal this from the parents—do parents who are subject to such a policy have standing to challenge it? Stay tuned.

Yesterday, I was honored to participate on a bipartisan legislative committee for the House and Senate discussing and approving draft ballot proposition [language](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=005bf30091&e=a7ab36849c) analyses for all the legislature’s referrals and citizen initiatives written by the Arizona Legislative Council to be used for November’s general election. Per A.R.S. section 19-124(C), it is required the Arizona Legislative Council prepare impartial analyses of ballot measures, which are then included in the publicity pamphlet published by the Secretary of State.

As a Club for Growth fellow, this afternoon I will receive an hour-long briefing from Kent Lassman, president and CEO of the Competitive Enterprise Institute who will discuss the regulatory state and America post-_Chevron_.

Thank you for your continued support as we work towards a victory in this contested primary election so we can move onto the contested general election to defend our Republican majority in the State Senate.

Take care,
Shawnna

Yesterday, I was honored to participate on a bipartisan legislative committee for the House and Senate discussing and approving draft ballot proposition analyses for all the legislature’s referrals and citizen initiatives written by the Arizona Legislative Council to be used for November’s general election. Per A.R.S. section 19-124(C), it is required the Arizona Legislative Council prepare impartial analyses of ballot measures, which are then included in the publicity pamphlet published by the Secretary of State. As a Club for Growth fellow, this afternoon I will receive an hour-long briefing from Kent Lassman, president and CEO of the Competitive Enterprise Institute who will discuss the regulatory state and America post-Chevron. Thank you for your continued support as we work towards a victory in this contested primary election so we can move onto the contested general election to defend our Republican majority in the State Senate. body:

Dear Peter,

We thought you may be interested to read this CONSERVATIVE NEWS ALERT:
Trump Seal of Approval Identifies Trump Endorsed Candidates, Committees to Avoid "Scammers" from Spreading False Information (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/07/trump-seal-of-approval-identifies-trump-endorsed-candidates-committees-to-avoid-scammers-from-spreading-false-information.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=38a7218c01-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/07/trump-seal-of-approval-identifies-trump-endorsed-candidates-committees-to-avoid-scammers-from-spreading-false-information.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=38a7218c01-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
The Trump Seal of Approval tells voters if the candidate or committee is officially endorsed.

By Illinois Review
In August of 2023, President Donald Trump unveiled a “Seal of Approval” (https://www.donaldjtrump.com/sealofapproval?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=38a7218c01-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D#:~:text=The%20purpose%20of%20the%20Seal,uses%20including%20oftentimes%20outright%20scams) to stop candidates and their supporters from falsely claiming that they are affiliated with or endorsed by his campaign to protect loyal donors and everyday supporters from political “scammers.”

The press release, which was released by the Trump campaign in the Summer of 2023, highlights the power of the Trump endorsement and why so many candidates, their supporters and committees seek it.

“President Trump’s endorsement power is the most powerful force in American politics. His influence is election defining. When President Trump posts an endorsement on Truth Social, or a candidate onstage before tens of thousands of voters, America First patriots rally behind President Trump’s choice and deliver a decisive victory.”
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/07/trump-seal-of-approval-identifies-trump-endorsed-candidates-committees-to-avoid-scammers-from-spreading-false-information.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=38a7218c01-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

But unfortunately, many candidates and political organizations falsely allege that they are “endorsed” by Trump or his campaign – when that simply isn’t the case, writing,

“To fight this scam, President Trump’s Seal will now include the right to use his name and likeness in fundraising solicitations and other campaign communications. The Seal will be a powerful signal to President Trump’s loyal donors that the sender is on Team Trump, and is not a scammer.”
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/07/trump-seal-of-approval-identifies-trump-endorsed-candidates-committees-to-avoid-scammers-from-spreading-false-information.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=38a7218c01-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

The release goes on to state that, “Candidates and committees authorized to use the Seal shall be permitted, and indeed encouraged, to use the Seal in connection with their activities on social media, in paid advertising, and on merchandise.”
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/07/trump-seal-of-approval-identifies-trump-endorsed-candidates-committees-to-avoid-scammers-from-spreading-false-information.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=38a7218c01-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
U.S. Rep. Nancy Mace displays the “Seal of Approval” on all campaign materials to identify that she is a Trump-endorsed candidate.

The Trump campaign also encourages Republicans in every state to review the campaign website (https://www.donaldjtrump.com/sealofapproval?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=38a7218c01-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D#:~:text=The%20purpose%20of%20the%20Seal,uses%20including%20oftentimes%20outright%20scams) to see the full list of candidates and committees endorsed by the 45th President of the United States.

By Illinois Review In August of 2023, President Donald Trump unveiled a “Seal of Approval” () to stop candidates and their supporters from falsely claiming that they are affiliated with or endorsed by his campaign to protect loyal donors and everyday supporters from political “scammers.” The press release, which was released by the Trump campaign in the Summer of 2023, highlights the power of the Trump endorsement and why so many candidates, their supporters and committees seek it. “President Trump’s endorsement power is the most powerful force in American politics. His influence is election defining. When President Trump posts an endorsement on Truth Social, or a candidate onstage before tens of thousands of voters, America First patriots rally behind President Trump’s choice and deliver a decisive victory.” CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE () But unfortunately, many candidates and political organizations falsely allege that they are “endorsed” by Trump or his campaign – when that simply isn’t the case, writing, “To fight this scam, President Trump’s Seal will now include the right to use his name and likeness in fundraising solicitations and other campaign communications. The Seal will be a powerful signal to President Trump’s loyal donors that the sender is on Team Trump, and is not a scammer.” CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE () The release goes on to state that, “Candidates and committees authorized to use the Seal shall be permitted, and indeed encouraged, to use the Seal in connection with their activities on social media, in paid advertising, and on merchandise.” U.S. Rep. Nancy Mace displays the “Seal of Approval” on all campaign materials to identify that she is a Trump-endorsed candidate. The Trump campaign also encourages Republicans in every state to review the campaign website () to see the full list of candidates and committees endorsed by the 45th President of the United States. The House could be won or lost in IL-17. If we want to flip the House blue and undo the damage done by extremists in the House, this is one of the most important races to win in 2024. Unlike McGraw and Johnson, we don't need buckets of special interest cash to win this race, but we do need to run our race effectively. That means hitting our internal fundraising goals and continuing to spread our message across the district. ~ ~** Let’s do this, -Eric | Paid for by Eric Sorensen for Illinois. Dear Friend,

I'm grateful to connect with you today and share an opportunity to impact the lives of our courageous missionaries serving in remote and challenging regions around the world.

In the farthest corners of the globe, these dedicated men, women, and families are sacrificing their comfort, security, and personal aspirations to bring the hope and transformative message of salvation to those who have never heard it before. With unwavering faith, they face incredible trials, enduring isolation, and even risking their safety to fulfill the calling placed upon their lives.

Yet, even people with the strongest commitment to their missionary calling can sometimes grow weary and feel discouraged. **That's where you come in.** I firmly believe that God can use your words of encouragement to reassure our missionaries that He is with them, strengthening them to press on.

Would you take a moment to write a note of encouragement to one of our missionaries serving in the field? Your notes of encouragement can be an instrument of hope God uses to remind them that they are not alone as they shine the light of the gospel in the darkest corners of the world. [
Will you help encourage a missionary serving in the field? Your message can be a lifeline, assuring them that their sacrifices are seen and deeply appreciated. ](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=670303cb7d114358858dd20418b9e06e&_e=zM6qLdbjCHZDeZgU3BIJbJx3ETL8NzQnSshR7Ahy29dnpyrmq-ZT_K2beYUubYnf-9PO2DXzcB_G665Mjs7nBNzxRwSLbWIoTxyuHrD5hMtgoSYGnIZdbgQXcLx9ZktHixTqJe47cMxXaQ__jMRlBZB49UXjyrq1oWakSZOScnllk63NBfxIvzBsU-P2Q30z8FRPtOdp-4Pa-rZuU5l44-kzBagN2Jn6aRiTPDFDN0Z6AOwL8wyw3nzk4mNlHEHqIZzkmWhI7cppj7V5CB0ENqW7RsGba_KbVivlRkwoXdd8yfqogZYwRXPpYkhRzXwMW8UtbwkFym-SmsxIhxyfAG2INr7ZCKKDgxCoOLDJO_HQYrHwv-Skfka-b30Q-1lL) **To send your note of encouragement, I invite you to fill out the secure form in this link:**

[https://welcome.imb.org/note_of_encouragement_lp.html](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=670303cb7d114358858dd20418b9e06e&_e=zM6qLdbjCHZDeZgU3BIJbJx3ETL8NzQnSshR7Ahy29dnpyrmq-ZT_K2beYUubYnf-9PO2DXzcB_G665Mjs7nBNzxRwSLbWIoTxyuHrD5hMtgoSYGnIZdbgQXcLx9ZktHixTqJe47cMxXaQ__jMRlBZB49UXjyrq1oWakSZOScnllk63NBfxIvzBsU-P2Q30z8FRPtOdp-4Pa-rZuU5l44zT0gYfTyzVgE8QGgYVRQ1-g-ZziQ7tgdtHnkYhITkrl5Ta6Y1aKI8_Xy7vypCzfPWizROXigG5woIWBQ0WRxe1Vfw6X62yH1-YyGpbdaHW5vYwyk9-0YhpOJouXna76Mj8cO03oxscxIEaJPUh17ITPZsfal2-P1-zfbnFKeSOM)

Thank you for your commitment to the Great Commission. Your support and prayers are invaluable in reaching those who have yet to experience the life-changing power of the gospel.

We are deeply grateful for your partnership in advancing the Kingdom of God.

In Christ,

Emily Hall

IMB Prayer Office

Peter, Growing up, Tina learned from her first-generation American parents the value of hard work, being active in the community, and following your dreams. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88549668/484462516/64599381?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&refcode=AU_TK_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240709_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MWRhYWZkNS0yMDNlLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=SL0ohoFQrQFaL7IJ989PmaS1WLNsvR1jYMytc7LEM2o=) She arrived in Oregon from the East Coast in 1987 and fell in love with the natural beauty of her new home, ultimately completing her undergraduate degree at the University of Oregon. In Oregon, she found a place where she could truly be herself. Tina came out as a lesbian in her early twenties and learned through her journey that advocating for herself and others was necessary to tackle bigotry and realize a just world for everyone. This commitment inspired her efforts in graduate school to fight for and win domestic partnership rights for students and faculty at the University of Washington. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88549669/484462517/64599381?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&refcode=AU_TK_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240709_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MWRhYWZkNS0yMDNlLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=SL0ohoFQrQFaL7IJ989PmaS1WLNsvR1jYMytc7LEM2o=) After graduate school, Tina returned to Oregon and joined the team at Oregon Food Bank. During her time there, she honed her skills as an advocate for others who have been overlooked and underserved. She continued her advocacy work as the policy director at Children First for Oregon (now Our Children Oregon), and this experience working with nonprofits on behalf of Oregon’s most vulnerable led her to run and serve in the Oregon Legislature. In 2013, Tina became the Oregon Speaker of the House. Through her leadership, the Oregon House passed progressive changes that expanded economic security for more families, combated climate change, and helped families in need during the pandemic. # Chapo Trap House, Democracy Now!, and Breaking Points highlight latest Drop Site scoop
### Instagram is shockingly censoring it, meanwhile
| | | [Ryan Grim](https://substack.com/@ryangrim)
---
| Jul 9
---
One thing the national debate about Biden's fitness for office has done is push the war on Gaza and Israel's lower-scale ongoing war with Lebanon almost entirely off the front pages. Yet ceasefire talks have resumed and Israel's attack on the West Bank - which, btw, is not run by Hamas! - has rapidly accelerated. ([This drone footage](https://substack.com/redirect/7fb49e07-30b7-4076-9b54-b9ab19329aac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) is not of Gaza, it's Tulkarem in the West Bank.)
The ceasefire talks are going on, meanwhile, in a media environment in which the American public hears routinely from one side of the war and quite-simply-never from the other side. That leaves gaping holes in our understanding of that conflict. It also leaves some glaring questions unanswered: What was Hamas thinking on October 7? Why did they launch the attack? Do they consider it a success despite the human cost of the response?
My colleague Jeremy Scahill explored these thorny questions directly with Hamas officials, some of whom agreed to speak on the record, [and we published his first dispatch this morning](https://substack.com/redirect/4b55e93a-0102-4b95-a9cc-b701f5ce73fd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). You won't find this kind of reporting anywhere else.

In fact, we're getting reports that Instagram is deleting posts from people who have shared Jeremy's article, warning that it "goes against our Community Guidelines on dangerous individuals and organizations." Ask anybody in Gaza, the IDF is also dangerous, but you're allowed to interview them.
Jeremy and I were on[ Chapo Trap House yesterday](https://substack.com/redirect/d22b4f45-53e9-4834-8bc1-e3f2242686f7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) talking about his reporting, as well as about Drop Site News in general. [We also went on Breaking Points](https://substack.com/redirect/12c26f19-c10b-430c-9358-f310525912af?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) this morning, and Jeremy [appeared on Democracy Now!](https://substack.com/redirect/ceb6c592-0702-498b-8397-af8f8b26fc1f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) with Amy Goodman. Instagram even appears to have taken down Democracy Now's post.
A snippet from Jeremy Scahill's story:
> On a tactical level, the October 7 operations exceeded Hamas's projections. "It was very surprising for us how speedy one of the strongest brigades in the Israel Army--the Gaza brigade is one of the strongest, most sophisticated groups of their army--to collapse within hours without any serious resistance, and that even the state as a whole, for hours and maybe days, continued to be paralyzed, were not able to respond in the proper professional way," said Dr. Basem Naim, a senior member of Hamas's political bureau and a former government minister in Gaza.
> "They were able to create this image of undefeated, undefeatable army, undefeatable soldiers, the long hand of Israel, which can hit everywhere or strike everywhere and come back, relax, to drink at some cafe in Tel Aviv, like what they have done in Iraq, in Syria, Lebanon, everywhere. I think it has shown that [Israel's self-promoted reputation] was not reflecting the reality." The attacks, he said, showed Palestinians and their allies that "Israel is defeatable and liberation of Palestine is a good possibility."
> ...
> Naim credited the October 7 attacks and the nine months of armed insurgency against the invading Israeli forces for elevating the plight of Palestinian liberation to the center of global attention. "This popular support everywhere, especially in America and Europe, do you believe this would happen by a workshop in Washington, D.C., discussing between Palestinians and Americans how to run Rafah crossings?" he asked. "Unfortunately, this is the way. There is no other way."
> Ghazi Hamad, the former Hamas deputy foreign minister and a longstanding member of its political bureau, told me that no one involved with the planning of the October 7 attacks that he spoke with predicted the full scope of Israel's response and that many Hamas leaders expected a more intense and prolonged version of previous Israeli attacks on Gaza. "This is a point that is very sensitive," he said. "No one expected this reaction from the Israel side, because what happened now in Gaza, it is a full destruction of Gaza, killing about 40,000 people, destroying all the institutions, hospitals and everything. I know the situation is horrible in Gaza. It's very, very hard. And we need at least ten years to reconstruct Gaza."
"This war is totally different," Hamad said. "Totally different."

# Patti’s Victory is Crucial for Coastal Georgia
---
| Hi Peter,
**What is happening?!

The Supreme Court just overturned a rule that’s been protecting us for 40 years. **This change means federal agencies now have less power to enforce critical regulations. Without these protections, we face greater risks to our environment, workplace safety, and fair financial practices.
**Why This Matters to Us:**
1. **Protecting Our Environment:** With this new ruling, big polluters have more freedom to damage our air, water, and natural resources. Patti is dedicated to fighting back, but she needs to be in Congress to do it.

2. **Supporting Working Families:** Safe working conditions and fair wages are now at risk. Without strong federal oversight, our workplaces could become more dangerous, and our wages could suffer. Patti will stand up for laws that protect us.

3. **Improving Healthcare and Education:** This ruling could weaken the healthcare and education services we all rely on. Patti’s commitment to expanding affordable healthcare and improving education is essential to make these services accessible and affordable.

**How You Can Help**
* **Volunteer:** Join our team to help spread Patti’s message. Every bit helps!

* **Spread the Word:** Tell your friends, family, and neighbors why this election is so important.

* **Donate:** Your financial support lets us reach more voters and make a bigger impact.

**Why Act Now?**
The stakes have never been higher. **This Supreme Court decision puts our community at immediate risk.** We need Patti in Congress to fight for us and push back against these threats. Every day we wait, the risk to our environment, safety, and livelihoods grows.
**Let’s make sure our government works for us, not against us.** Stand with Patti and let’s create a safer, fairer, and healthier future for Coastal Georgia together.
Thank you so much for your support!

| |

| | | I endured the gauntlet of West Point Military Academy, then boot camp, then became a Tank Platoon Leader in the final days of the Cold War.

I briefed President Trump on America's most classified matters of national security while Director of CIA.

And I stood eye-to-eye with the most dangerous dictators in the world as Trump's Secretary of State.

**It takes a lot to make me feel on edge. So the fact that I 'm even sending you this email should give you pause. **

Because I'm afraid we have a problem. A big one.

I just got word that Joe Biden and the Democrats are _closer than they 've ever been before_ to destroying our Conservative House Majority once and for all. The latest reports show they've stockpiled over $100,000,000 to defeat us in enough swing states to bring forth a COMPLETE LIBERAL TAKEOVER.

The ONLY THING standing in the way of Joe Biden having full control - and ramming through any radical policy he wants - is just a few competitive House seats. That's it.

I don't tell you this lightly and I know that's not what you want to see happen to our country.

_**[That's why I'm rushing to you, in partnership with Majority Leader Steve Scalise, to raise a game-changing one million dollars in the next 72 hours.](http://links.rightwaypress.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=32a17afd084149a0ad6151690602ead8&_e=meryTn101oRGS-OCHoy_3-LhntyBQm-eiHfEUTaXwcVN7VouG2irWfLHXvnF9mMZ_yrmsbh4jddgkajLP31zkVpm2_i-OK9IatYilsdo3h56ItkcUraj8-M40gvsA8P038eMFcKlyQ4iccwQCyMRjctg_ppQI5EzspLTq0KwCAjs3qzAXBiQKIio8nOKI3x2QT5xrB4GmX7ooDxLpAG7S2v5pEAu5_S1qLkIboV2mDJ9b_qEolMq_mFuCKn2CsWNGDotyJ9MbX5thQExTLDTbYxACtWkLkB0V8qU8mIFKR-ChNmOs3n1rAHEOE6QsAxH4QSfCLlGzJ60E2rtkZZbLKm_Hv25Ct7YMHSkBqAloIBRShGc66keTeotOxDY6bVFjfX-Bz91Nwpuz7JFGkiH1WwSJJ2hxKDE0RVxoLtKyoQ%3D "That’s why I’m rushing to you, in partnership with Majority Leader Steve Scalise, to raise a game-changing one million dollars in the next 72 hours.")**_ I know what you're thinking... that's not enough runway to raise that much. No Green has ever been on the ballot here.

| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=resend_ok_d_nd_lte_50&n=1)

Peter – A few days ago we wrote you about an exciting chance to write history by making Jill Stein the first Green Party candidate ever to get on the ballot in Oklahoma. We wanted to make sure you don't miss out on helping Jill with this momentous opportunity. We are getting closer to the goal, and your support will be the key to getting real democracy on the Oklahoma ballot. [**Will you pitch in whatever you can today to give over 2.3 million voters in Oklahoma a real choice - and help Jill make history?**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/ok?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=resend_ok_d_nd_lte_50&n=2)

---
Oklahoma has long been one of the most difficult states to petition to get on the ballot, but a law passed in 2017 introduced an option for presidential candidates to gain ballot access by paying a $35,000 filing fee. That’s still a hefty chunk of change for a grassroots campaign like ours. That said, it actually costs less than hiring paid petitioners to collect tens of thousands of signatures - not to mention the likely need to defend those signatures from legal challenges by the anti-Democratic Party’s army of lawyers. Oklahoma is also one of several states that don’t allow write-in votes, meaning Oklahomans have never yet had the opportunity to vote for a Green presidential candidate. We can make history by putting Jill on Oklahoma’s ballot - but because the government has delayed the federal matching funds payments we qualified for and expected to start arriving this week, we urgently need to raise $35,000 for the Oklahoma filing fee by the fast-approaching deadline of July 15th. **If everyone reading this gives just $10 or more right now, we can declare another ballot access victory for Jill today.** [**Please give whatever you can today to make sure that over 2.3 million voters in Oklahoma will have an anti-genocide, pro-worker, climate action choice on their ballot for the first time ever!**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/ok?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=resend_ok_d_nd_lte_50&n=5)

## [** _Senate Committee Advances Bill to Draft Women into the U.S. Military_**](https://ssspl.mjt.lu/lnk/AWUAAEhly5kAAc4IKNAAA5vbC1wAAYDOz7cAnf7RACZcGQBmjYS5C2O_5_F7ROqu_)

---
**Members of the U.S. Senate Armed Services Committee have advanced a bill that, if passed, paves the way for requiring women to register to be drafted into the U.S. military.** The committee passed its version of the National Defense Authorization Act on June 13 by a vote of 22-3. It authorizes $923 billion for fiscal 2025 funding for national defense, including a 4.5% pay increase for all troops.It also includes a provision to amend the Military Selective Service Act to require women to register with the Selective Services System (SSS), the database that is used for a draft.

clean_body: Drafting Women, the Media Lied, Rogue D.A.s, and more... | | | | | | Members of the U.S. Senate Armed Services Committee have advanced a bill that, if passed, paves the way for requiring women to register to be drafted into the U.S. military. The committee passed its version of the National Defense Authorization Act on June 13 by a vote of 22-3. It authorizes $923 billion for fiscal 2025 funding for national defense, including a 4.5% pay increase for all troops.It also includes a provision to amend the Military Selective Service Act to require women to register with the Selective Services System (SSS), the database that is used for a draft. | PLEASE SUPPORT OUR SPONSORS | IMPORTANT DETAILS DATES: June 1, 2024 through August 15, 2024 DRAWING: Winners will be drawn on August 16, 2024 FIRST PRIZE: Solaire Infrared Grill and 1 year of Backyard Butchers SECOND PLACE: Solaire Anywhere Grill with Warming Rack and 6-month supply of Backyard Butchers THIRD PLACE: Solaire Mini Grill and a 3-month supply of Backyard Butchers | NOTABLE QUOTES Naomi Wolf contributor to Frontpage Magazine: What you need to understand is that debanking, loss of medical licenses, deplatforming, fines, are all mere annoyances that go along with the late-stage decline of free civil societies. | Recent weeks have seen _tremendous_ court victories for medical liberty. Between a landmark ruling by the US Supreme Court and various lower court settlements, the tide seems to be turning in the wake of COVID tyranny. First, a federal court had granted class-action status to over **2000 airline employers** who allege they were discriminated against by United Airlines when they opted against the COVID vaccine. The court’s decision opens the possibility of up to $1 billion in damages being paid out if the plaintiffs prevail. Then, health insurance giant Blue Cross Blue Shield was **ordered to pay** $680,000 to a former employee who faced adverse action from the company when she declined to get the COVID jab. Lastly, TFVC is celebrating a monumental victory for medical liberty with the potential **overturning of Chevron Deference,** a legal precedent which gave federal agencies such as the CDC, FDA and OSHA great power to institute rules and regulations without oversight. As the legal community processes this pivotal shift in case law, **TFVC stands ready to continue advocating for the rights and choices of Texans.****

Friend, I need you to know about this.

Within minutes of my victory in the GOP Primary for Governor, the mainstream media launched a coordinated ambush against me.

Hateful articles, vicious attacks on cable television. All to slander my good name to millions of voters and destroy our chances of winning on Election Day.

_**Hell, they even called me a nazi.**_

Friend, I'll be honest with you-

The media isn't going to stop their war against me, and I expect to be fighting back against their attacks every day until Election Day.

But our campaign for Governor simply can't survive this without your support.

Can I count on you to stand with me against the media's vicious lies?

clean_body: The latest from the League | July 9, 2024 | Outdoor access By eliminating the largest barrier between underrepresented communities and redwood parks, the League program is expanding outdoor access and inspiring the next generation to care about the forest. Policy news Thanks to vocal advocacy from our supporters, California lawmakers have approved a $10 billion climate resilience bond to go before voters in November. Join us in celebrating this important step towards safeguarding our natural lands and local communities. Summer heat Longing to escape the swelter? Head to one of these shady redwood parks, home to swimming holes, picnic sites, and a dense forest canopy that acts like a giant sun umbrella. Tribal engagement In recent years, the Yurok Tribe has pushed to restore ancestral names to sites across redwood country, including ‘O Rew, Sue-meg, and Chah-pekw O’ Ket’-toh. Each reclaimed name is an opportunity to shape the narrative around colonialism and Indigenous culture. Calendar contest A curious bear, blooming dogwoods, a sunrise, a starry sky— our four photo finalists will sweep you away to the redwood forest...but only one can grace the cover of the 2025 League calendar. Pick your favorite before voting ends July 12! Travel If you thought Northern California had a monopoly on spectacular sempervirens, guess again. As a mother, I love all of my children to the moon. It is unacceptable that my four daughters now have fewer rights than I did when I was their age.
I was able to decide for myself when to have children, and I believe every person should have that same autonomy.

body:
Did you see Ted Cruz's interview?
http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-allred [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-allred]
We all saw with our own eyes what happened after the 2020 election: Ted Cruz cheered on the mob on January 6, led the objection to the election results certification, and then hid in a supply closet.
And spoiler alert: He's ready to do it again.
We can’t let him. This November is our chance to finally hold him accountable by kicking him out of the Senate for good.
Polls currently show him and Colin Allred TIED in Texas, but this is shaping up to be the most expensive race in the country. So please, will you chip in $100, $50, $10, or whatever to Colin’s campaign and Serve America to help Colin defeat Ted Cruz and bring real, pro-democracy leadership to Texas? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-allred]
Ted Cruz has proven time and again to be the single most divisive politician in Washington. From leading the charge on the 2012 government shutdown to ushering in an era of extreme hyper-partisanship and pitting Americans against each other with dangerous, extremist rhetoric. Ted isn't just Texans' problem – he's ALL AMERICANS’ problem.
Ted Cruz's refusal to commit to accepting election results is exactly the kind of rhetoric that led to January 6, and another six years of him in the Senate is a danger our democracy simply can’t afford.
As a former voting rights lawyer, Colin knows firsthand how critical it is that we all remain committed to protecting our democracy and ensuring that something like January 6 never happens again. Texans deserve a leader who respects our democracy – and Colin will unequivocally accept the results of this election.
If you agree that Ted Cruz's extreme, anti-democracy rhetoric needs to go, please chip in now to Colin and Serve America to help us defeat him. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-allred]

Friend, I need you to know about this.

Within minutes of my victory in the GOP Primary for Governor, the mainstream media launched a coordinated ambush against me.

Hateful articles, vicious attacks on cable television. All to slander my good name to millions of voters and destroy our chances of winning on Election Day.

_**Hell, they even called me a nazi.**_

Friend, I'll be honest with you-

The media isn't going to stop their war against me, and I expect to be fighting back against their attacks every day until Election Day.

| **Ron Pickard for U.S. Congress Kicks off Convention Week**
Watch Ron Pickard’s newest video where he kicks off convention week and stresses the importance of proper representation for the Virgin Islands on the national stage!
---
[](https://republicanpartyinthevirginislands.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9aec4429d4907d8f643606ded&id=65d4a40ea8&e=4f81ceec6f)

| **RNC Platform: Greater Participation from VI**
The RNC's 2024 Platform has taken a strong stance in support of the U.S. territories, including the Virgin Islands.
This can be found in Chapter 9 : Section 7, Page 15 of the platform.
_Republicans Will Protect Americans in the Territories._
_The territories of Guam, the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands, American Samoa, the U.S. Virgin Islands, and Puerto Rico are of vital importance to our National Security, and we welcome their greater participation in all aspects of the political process._
We thank April Newland for service on the Platform Committee both in support of the Trump campaign and the U.S. Virgin Islands. This is a strong and promising start to our shared goal of increasing the representation of the VI on the national stage.
Click this link to access the full platform.
---
[Full 2024 Platform](https://republicanpartyinthevirginislands.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9aec4429d4907d8f643606ded&id=b4211ef5d7&e=4f81ceec6f)
|
---
| **RPVI National Convention Delegation**
Going into convention week we recognize those who have been chosen to represent the RPVI in Milwaukee:
John Yob - State Chairman - Delegation Chairman - Platform
Jevon Williams - National Committeeman - Permanent Organization
Antoinette Gumbs-Hecht - National Committeewoman - Permanent Organization
Delegate - April Newland - Platform

In key battleground states, polls indicate that Trump has gained a significant lead following the first presidential debate, compared to previous weeks. According to the average of major polls, Trump now holds an advantage of +3.3 percentage points in the race.(RealClearPolls).

The left is in a full panic right now, but I WANT Biden to remain the nominee. I explain here:
[](https://substack.com/redirect/a2a800a2-e822-4e96-a7e5-7238a74ed612?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
## Watch "Trump's Front Row Joes" ⬇️⬇️⬇️
My documentary about the Trump movement, what its like at a Trump rally, the real stories of people who attend all the rallies, why the media won't cover them and where the movement will go after President Trump.
[Watch it here now](https://substack.com/redirect/77871e15-b8c6-4dcf-9be6-c9e4fa352f26?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I sat down with President Trump to talk about how he feels about his loyal supporters; Congresswoman Marjorie Taylor Greene told us about what it is like for her to be at Trump rallies; Steve Bannon, who has been watching since 2015, compared these supporters to deadheads, and even reporters who have been covering Trump since 2015 talk about how unique this is in politics.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/77871e15-b8c6-4dcf-9be6-c9e4fa352f26?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

## "I know how to tell the truth"
After the debate, Biden did a rally where he told the crowd that he might not walk the way he used or speech as smooth, but he knows how to tell the truth. Well, the RNC struck back today to launch factcheckbiden.com, cataloging years of misstatements.
## 6 days until the convention - RNC reveals platform
20 solid points laid out in a way that makes a case for a second Trump term. While this is the platform of the party I think most of these 20 issues would garner 80-90% support of the public at large.
[Read the whole PDF here](https://substack.com/redirect/b6ae88a5-eccf-472c-9779-a5ed881170d3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**RNC PROGRAM ANNOUNCED! - Yesterday, the Donald J. Trump Campaign, together with the Republican National Committee, released program themes for the "Make America Great Once Again" Convention in Milwaukee.**
**The themes are:**
* **Monday: Make America** _**Wealthy**_**Once Again**
* **Tuesday: Make America** _**Safe**_**Once Again**
* **Wednesday: Make America** _**Strong**_**Once Again**

**Thursday: Make America** _**Great**_**Once Again**
VP announcement?
Trump teased on Hannity last night it was likely to come before the official start of the convention next Monday. That makes sense -- you need a few days for the eventual nominee to get up to speed and ready for their big debut and speech. My guess its Saturday of this week because Biden is doing a press conference (a BIG BOY one!) and they wont wan to step on that.
## Stories I'm Reading...
[Biden's physician was also a family business associat](https://substack.com/redirect/54a93a93-961f-4bf2-9155-d6c695b9a3b7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)e -- via Politico
> My take: Its full blue on blue - Politico going after Biden's doctor.
[Ben Shapiro, the Right's Millennial Moses, Builds Empire in Wilderness ](https://substack.com/redirect/c8d0ff12-3856-4ba9-ab8b-a1dfbf9158fa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)-- via RealClearPolitics
> My take: Great piece by Philip Wegmann on the role of Daily Wire Plus
[Scoop: How Biden's event staffers guide him behind the scenes](https://substack.com/redirect/5ab58bab-890e-4786-a98c-1f6e11bbb83e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) -- via Axios
[Behind the Curtain: Unbendable Biden vs. breaking-point Dems](https://substack.com/redirect/6441b1cf-27e8-4424-b3b6-e9b258b76057?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) -- via Axios
> My take: For over 2 years, the media has covered for this White House. Now, all the left-wing outlets, Huffington Post, CNN, and even Axios are bailing. It is a problem. And this week, House members are back in DC, which makes it much harder to duck questions.
[Scoop: House Democrats whip against Republicans' latest election crackdown](https://substack.com/redirect/1aa39abe-73fb-490e-bb99-4afaf1d7fe8a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) -- via Axios
> My take: House Democrats, and Axios, are opposed to a bill that would require ID to vote in a federal election.
## Friday could be the end...
We are almost two weeks out from the debate, and the fallout continues. Two weeks! Congress is back in DC this week, and Democrat members of the House and Senate are trying desperately to avoid the media. This should be a no-brainer - he is the nominee, and he isn't budging. Trump said the same thing on Hannity last night - they are his delegates, and it's his and ONLY his choice whether to step aside, and it's clear he has no intention of doing so. So why won't House and Senate Democrats just say it - he is the nominee? The reason is simple...

---
Peter, I grew up across the street from one of Donald Trump's golf courses in New York. This one, in fact: ↘↘ [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88556072/484484565/-723981995?amount=3&refcode=RTFC_20240709_EMDF_E1_T0_AC_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjE2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ZTRiZDIwNS0zMjNlLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=SdE2Rh8S5mAY6P8SK7dfPT391mEohI0-iZQgZBUAuCE=) Yes, really. But it was not the way I think you're picturing it in your mind — let me explain.

I didn't live in a skyrise apartment or a mansion with luxuries at my fingertips.

**I grew up in the Throggs Neck Houses, a crumbling public housing project among vermin, lead, and mold, across from Trump's Golf Course in The Bronx.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88556073/484484566/-723981995?amount=3&refcode=RTFC_20240709_EMDF_E1_T0_AC_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjE2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ZTRiZDIwNS0zMjNlLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=SdE2Rh8S5mAY6P8SK7dfPT391mEohI0-iZQgZBUAuCE=) My mom was a single mom, working multiple jobs to keep food on the table. I'm so grateful for how much she sacrificed to provide for our family.

Living across from Trump's Golf Course, I had to see a reminder every day of how easily and often our government supports and enables the ultra-wealthy at the expense of working families.

You see, the New York City government shoveled over _$100 million in government aid_ to develop this golf course with Donald Trump and the corrupt Trump Organization. _They did this while New York families like mine lived in hunger and poverty across the street._

But, I always try to look at the positives — growing up smelling the stench of Donald Trump (even before he became president) has led me to where I am today: **Fighting in Congress for justice for real working families.**

When I work on legislation, I always think about the families who are struggling just like mine did. I lived that experience — it is not abstract to me. And I'll never forget it.

I hope you feel like you have a better sense of who I am and what my values are. I swear that I'm fighting for those values every day in Congress.

Right now, the shadow of Trump and his MAGA cult looms large. They're determined to strip our right to vote, give tax breaks to people like Trump, and put special interests ahead of working families _– and they’re raising millions to pull it off._

But we have something they don’t, Peter: A powerful grassroots movement made up of working people, not faceless corporations. [**Can I count on you to join our coalition today by chipping in $3 toward our $2,000 daily goal? If thousands of people like you each chip in what they can afford, I know we can take on their dark money and reclaim our House Majority. »**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88556074/484484567/-723981995?amount=3&refcode=RTFC_20240709_EMDF_E1_T0_AC_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjE2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ZTRiZDIwNS0zMjNlLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=SdE2Rh8S5mAY6P8SK7dfPT391mEohI0-iZQgZBUAuCE=) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $3 »](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88556081/484484574/-723981995?amount=3&express_lane=true&refcode=RTFC_20240709_EMDF_E1_T0_AC_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjE2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ZTRiZDIwNS0zMjNlLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=SdE2Rh8S5mAY6P8SK7dfPT391mEohI0-iZQgZBUAuCE=)

Ritchie Torres represents the future of the Democratic Party. Raised by a single mother in public housing, Ritchie personally understands the hardships that working families endure. At age 25, Ritchie made history as the youngest elected official to serve on the New York City Council. But it was not the way I think you're picturing it in your mind — let me explain. I didn't live in a skyrise apartment or a mansion with luxuries at my fingertips. I grew up in the Throggs Neck Houses, a crumbling public housing project among vermin, lead, and mold, across from Trump's Golf Course in The Bronx. = My mom was a single mom, working multiple jobs to keep food on the table. I'm so grateful for how much she sacrificed to provide for our family. Living across from Trump's Golf Course, I had to see a reminder every day of how easily and often our government supports and enables the ultra-wealthy at the expense of working families. You see, the New York City government shoveled over $100 million in government aid to develop this golf course with Donald Trump and the corrupt Trump Organization. They did this while New York families like mine lived in hunger and poverty across the street. But, I always try to look at the positives — growing up smelling the stench of Donald Trump (even before he became president) has led me to where I am today: Fighting in Congress for justice for real working families. | **_GET TO KNOW CURTIS_**

**Curtis Bashaw is a hotel entrepreneur, job creator, and preservationist. He's running for United States Senate to provide greater freedom and opportunities for all New Jerseyans.**

A lifelong New Jersey resident, Curtis grew up in Camden County and spent his summers at the Jersey Shore working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. He has spent his life in the real estate and hospitality industries, and is the Founder and Managing Partner of Cape Resorts, a hotel company focusing on the restoration and operation of classic American resort properties in New Jersey and New York.

Throughout his career, Curtis has worked to build communities and bring people together. He is widely recognized for leading the landmark restorations of Congress Hall and the Virginia Hotel in Cape May, and for launching creative programming to dramatically extend Cape May's season, a catalyst for the economic rebirth of one of the Jersey Shore's most beautiful communities.

Curtis is a successful businessman and job creator, employing more than 1,000 people in New Jersey and New York. Curtis' company owns and operates eight hotels, ten cottages, six restaurants, four retail outlets and a working farm, all on the Jersey Shore and Long Island's East End. Curtis lives in Cape May with his husband, Will.
