# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=38971%2E3422442%2EEQqyFO)
Derek,
Katie Porter here. You may have noticed that the emails I’m sending you look a bit different than the ones I used to send and now say “Truth to Power” at the top.
**My term serving CA-47 in the House runs through early January.** And until then, I’ll be doing everything I can to get some of our top priority pieces of legislation across the finish line. That includes continuing to push for banning Members of Congress from trading stocks; holding Big Oil accountable; and using the Oversight Committee to get real answers for the American people.
I’m still focused on the future of our Congress, because I’ve seen how desperately we need to enact real change. On the campaign trail, I heard from so many Californians who distrust government and are losing faith in our democracy’s ability to deliver for them. People see how beholden politicians are to their biggest donors and special interest groups. And, they don’t like the end result.
That’s why in 2020, as a freshman Member of Congress, I started Truth to Power. Truth to Power is a “Leadership PAC,” which is a campaign finance term that just means a political entity run by an elected official.
Since 2020, Truth to Power has been able to spend over $500,000 directly supporting Democrats and has raised more than $125,000 directly into candidates’ campaigns. We’ve endorsed and supported Democrats who reject corporate PAC money and are running to protect the environment, restore the nationwide right to an abortion, and create an economy that works for working people.
This work is only possible because of people like you, who believe we must rid Washington of corporate influence.
**[Is there anything you can give to Truth to Power to send a powerful message to corporate interests, and help us support Democrats in must-win races across the country?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20240709?refcode=em20240709-38971&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=38971_3422442_EQqyFO&akid=38971%2E3422442%2EEQqyFO)

Thanks for considering,
Katie Porter

| | Fellow Patriot, I remember it like it was yesterday. My father was working in West Africa, and we were living there when radical Iranians invaded the U.S. embassy in Tehran.

As a precaution, the U.S. Marines brought all U.S. citizens and green card holders to the U.S. Embassy. The look on their eyes said _“_ _Nothing will happen to you tonight. Not on my watch”_

In that moment, I knew I wanted to be JUST like them. **I wanted to grow up and defend the country that gave safe harbor to me and my family.**
Fast forward ten years, and I attended the U.S. Naval Academy and served for 25 years as a Navy Special Operations Officer, retiring as a Captain.

There is no honor like serving your country, and I’m ready for a new capacity of service: **representing the Commonwealth of Virginia in the U.S. Senate.**

**[Before I tell you a little bit about why I’m running, would you consider pitching in a few bucks to our campaign?](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=886791da2012475cbddf548f865a7e0e&_e=CDCpLxNSs-dCCjcIcdLTRje9D73estS-e7tub0KLgTh7nc50t3DxfMbtkLqg-8KSE4nXAxTYwZhuIEnDXH4kxOGZmlrUDK0TRxayFttweYZ0oEfKKbTAAov-VjRJdgq-BgrRNJvZEsuOg-G3K9BRKb0FwqgPIuGyFMEWbmkaB6GcTbxv3Y6Vd4pX2BcPbjMRfZdDnX0EiD30HIdsB0AB3kpMVnqaLzqGLA5uqTeEKBetmNd2SDwvT2jOad8p3AiAL4ZE1EsShiOLUTriek8NZlE9fFTHPd5K7qW_m3AovWaSEPXJdR1SD9BX4Qvuo9z79fI02sqoxtZXLOwCImX0vu9gXq1NyWPfJsWweFnT6-gCPxqBKzG1StpdIITKiSHY)**

You see, there’s a Latin saying we like to use in the Navy: **“ Non sibi sed patriae.” It means “not self but country,” and it’s a phrase that’s foreign to too many of today’s politicians. **

Politicians like Tim Kaine have completely lost touch with the American people. They’d rather keep our borders wide open to criminals than take care of our veterans and our law-abiding citizens. They’re more interested in keeping special, high-dollar interests happy than serving the people who elected them.

As someone who dedicated my life to fighting for our country, it makes me absolutely sick.

I risked my life to keep America safe, and now, politicians like Tim Kaine are throwing away all of our servicemembers’ hard work.

_I won’t sit back idly and let him do that without a fight._

**[I’ve fought for America before, and I’ll do it again - but I can’t win alone. clean_body: I've fought for America before, and I'll do it again - but I can't win alone. Can I count on you?| | | | | Fellow Patriot, I remember it like it was yesterday. My father was working in West Africa, and we were living there when radical Iranians invaded the U.S. embassy in Tehran. As a precaution, the U.S. Marines brought all U.S. citizens and green card holders to the U.S. Embassy. The look on their eyes said “ Nothing will happen to you tonight. Not on my watch” In that moment, I knew I wanted to be JUST like them. I wanted to grow up and defend the country that gave safe harbor to me and my family. Fast forward ten years, and I attended the U.S. Naval Academy and served for 25 years as a Navy Special Operations Officer, retiring as a Captain. There is no honor like serving your country, and I’m ready for a new capacity of service: representing the Commonwealth of Virginia in the U.S. Senate. You see, there’s a Latin saying we like to use in the Navy: “ Non sibi sed patriae.” It means “not self but country,” and it’s a phrase that’s foreign to too many of today’s politicians. Politicians like Tim Kaine have completely lost touch with the American people. They’d rather keep our borders wide open to criminals than take care of our veterans and our law-abiding citizens. They’re more interested in keeping special, high-dollar interests happy than serving the people who elected them. As someone who dedicated my life to fighting for our country, it makes me absolutely sick. I risked my life to keep America safe, and now, politicians like Tim Kaine are throwing away all of our servicemembers’ hard work. I won’t sit back idly and let him do that without a fight. What happens when you have the audacity to claim that America is _not_ a Christian nation? **Let 's Address This **in a new issue of "**Hate Mail of the Weak**."
I periodically share this more personal side of my advocacy for human rights because it is important to me that you, my gracious supporters, see what I see. Apologies in advance for the vulgar language in the screen shots below.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..I4e_HVoRnnUKE-UD7PWeHnua4X5CUDrviQQ0bNzw9jw?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=146342747)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ae2b02f1-0962-4fb7-be4d-abc9e50cd282?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**It all started when I posted two tweets condemning a Louisiana law mandating displaying the 10 Commandments in public schools.** I was frustrated that Louisiana continues to neglect the health and well-being of their own children, yet is ready to enforce religious instruction in the classroom. Yes, [they really are](https://substack.com/redirect/bf73dbbf-549a-4866-b3ca-3c98fbd0f913?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/800cb349-8732-4eb0-8ac6-30df01dd28a9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
I followed up with a short thread pointing out that compulsion in matters of faith is ineffective, extremist, and a failing strategy altogether.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/53013b4e-733f-47e4-bc8e-573e340a22f2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Finally I proposed an idea!** If this really is about education and not evangelism, then let's teach about all faiths in a secular, objective environment for the benefit of all.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2ffb5faa-d2d8-4e6e-b2af-5f0572037407?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**My posts gained popularity, ultimately gaining over 5000 retweets and 10,000 likes.** Then, like clockwork, that drew the ire of those offended that I dare suggest that America is _not_ a Christian nation.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0779fbb2-f88b-4fe6-90c0-69c915fa0f89?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
In response, I shared the factual receipts that the Government of the United States is not, in any sense, founded on the Christian religion.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6b836c08-c75a-46fb-9cfd-e74b35d21a62?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..I4e_HVoRnnUKE-UD7PWeHnua4X5CUDrviQQ0bNzw9jw?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=146342747)
However, I've noticed such folks are not necessarily interested in facts. Hence, the next response was classical Islamophobia and ignorance to the fact that Muslims also believe in the 10 Commandments
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b6f980d6-404c-4dae-a990-1e5ed8b4d671?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
And then that hate escalated to dehumanizing bigotry.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a5f5be4a-f875-42a4-8dd9-0b4d22004644?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
And then that dehumanizing bigotry escalated into genocidal violence.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e792c1d7-f449-415b-9bf0-57a4dc641a79?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
To be sure, I reported these hateful violent tweets to Twitter. I would have assumed that calling on the mass murder of 1.6 billion Muslims might violate their terms of service? Unsurprisingly, Twitter found no problem with this genocidal rhetoric and refused to remove these tweets.
I stopped trying to reason with the extremist calling for violence, and instead responded with facts and receipts to shut down the ignorance:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/96abf1eb-434b-483a-ab9e-2f65b2019557?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
And there were variations of this Islamophobic ignorance as well. Some more aggressive and incendiary than others. For example:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/4544d81e-41b5-46da-8157-cadec5736f6b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
This is a classic shifting of goal posts. When one claim is debunked, those offended shift to a new claim. In this case, the commenter ignored my actual argument and attacked my faith as a Muslim with meritless allegations. I responded in detail. Note in particular, point 3.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7bb0f536-5769-4502-b9e3-3cc325c80995?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
I mean for crying out loud women in America had to wait until the Equal Credit Opportunity Act of 1974--nearly 200 years after America's founding--before they were afforded the right to basic financial access. Marital rape wasn't criminalized until 1993. I could have given a more detailed response by pointing out that misogyny and patriarchy are global phenomenons, that [not a single nation on Earth treats women with equality](https://substack.com/redirect/1d95aa9a-cea5-4955-bc63-60fffc3f2bed?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and that the [United States is itself among the top 10 most dangerous nations on Earth for women](https://substack.com/redirect/eb30d941-e5b0-4080-a9d2-848d37f44c5c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Indeed, if the only time you care about women's rights is when _other_ nations are abusive to women, then it isn't women's rights you care about.
In my work as an attorney supporting survivors of domestic and sexual violence, I've represented women of the Islamic faith, as well as of the Christian faith, Jewish faith, Hindu faith, and women of no faith. This is why it is critical that all men of all faiths and backgrounds stand united to stop men from being abusive towards women. That is how we stop this scourge--not by demonizing any one faith or racial demographic.
Returning to the topic at hand, the beauty of our country is that it is a government built on the separation of religion and state. We are not a Christian nation, Muslim nation, Jewish nation, Sikh nation, or atheist nation. We are a United States built on a secular government that mandates equal justice for all. Such a government affords each of us to believe, or not believe, without government oppression and interference. That is what true freedom of conscience entails.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..I4e_HVoRnnUKE-UD7PWeHnua4X5CUDrviQQ0bNzw9jw?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=146342747)
**Indeed,** we must recognize that one goal of Project 2025 is to transform our secular government into a Christian theocracy. You can [read my summary and assessment of this fascist plan here](https://substack.com/redirect/8663f77d-d862-4b00-9eb8-f223953d3e23?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). It is no surprise, therefore, that Oklahoma is now also [mandating Bible study in its public schools](https://substack.com/redirect/c8246cbc-4c68-46ee-ae31-dd942550cf33?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). This trend will likely continue unabated under our right wing MAGA Supreme Court. And this is why we cannot sit silent, but must stay active and demand accountability. We do this by investing our time and resources to elevate the people doing the work to build that more compassionate and just future. You have my promise to always speak up for justice above all else, period.
**In closing, let me reemphasize my appreciation to each of you for supporting my work and advocacy.** Whether you [subscribe](https://substack.com/redirect/b4003c05-7635-40da-9175-b16b1100bced?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for free or at $5/mo, $50/year, or the singular Founding Member at $500/year--your support to keep building is critical.
_**Are you in?**_
P.S. In the next episode of Hate Mail of the Weak, I'll share what happens when you answer a MAGAs complaints about "_Spanish and Middle Eastern speaking people conquering a Columbus suburb_." (Yes that's an actual quote).

clean_body: We must unite as a party. We must focus our attention and our efforts on defeating Donald Trump. | | | Peter -- I just sent a letter to Democrats in Congress to make it clear: I am staying in this race, and we're going to win. Look, I have heard the concerns that people have, the good-faith fears and worries about what is at stake in this election. I am not blind to them. Believe me, I know better than anyone the responsibility and the burden the nominee of our party carries. But let me say clearly and unequivocally: I wouldn't be running if I did not absolutely believe that I can and I will beat Donald Trump in November. Now we must unite as a party. We must focus our attention and our efforts on defeating Trump, on defending American democracy, and on protecting people's freedoms. | | | I feel a deep obligation to trust the voters of the Democratic Party. Millions of you cast a ballot for me and Kamala in primaries across the country. That's the process. It was a decision for voters to make -- not the press, the pundits, the big donors, or any powerful interest group. Look at what happened when we stood together in 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023. We won. Because the fact of the matter is we have a historic record of success to run on. We are the ones creating millions of jobs. The ones lowering costs for families, protecting Social Security and Medicare, combating climate change, and providing student debt relief. There are 41 days until the Democratic National Convention. Any weakening of resolve or lack of clarity only helps Trump. | | Folks, I've been energized by the determination this team has shown over recent weeks. Thank you from the bottom of my heart, Joe Joe Biden President of the United States **

# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20240709-1&t=1&akid=905%2E587540%2E09ie0D)
_Please use the links in this email to start a monthly donation._
Hi Peter, it's David Hogg.
I’m writing with a big ask: [**I’m hoping that, if you can, you’ll start a monthly recurring donation of $5 or more to Leaders We Deserve today.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240709-1?refcode=em20240709-1&amount=5&recurring=true&refcode2=905_587540_09ie0D&akid=905%2E587540%2E09ie0D) And if you give me just a minute, I’ll explain how supporting us in this way makes such a big difference in what we’re able to do.
When my friend Kevin Lata and I launched Leaders We Deserve last summer, we were blown away by the amount of support we got right at the start.
Thanks to grassroots supporters across the country, we were about to invest **over $100,000** into Nadarius Clark’s race and help him become the youngest member of the Virginia legislature just a few months after our launch ALREADY he just passed a gun safety law and killed a bill to arm teachers. That’s a big deal!
**This November, we’ve endorsed 12 more incredible young leaders who we’re pulling out all the stops to support as well.**
When you set up a monthly recurring donation, you’re helping give us a baseline for how much we’ll be bringing in on a monthly basis. That helps us plan for recurring expenses like rent on our office, travel to meet with candidates, salaries for staff (we just hired a new Development Director), and more. Too often donations rise and drop dramatically with the news cycle these donations really help elect candidates because a dollar in July has 5x the impact of one in October.
Let’s be clear, though. When it comes to our office expenses, we’re pretty cheap! The vast majority of what we raise goes directly to **electing young leaders** across the country.
But here’s the thing: the less we have to worry about organizational costs, **the more we get to spend on helping our candidates win**. And like I said, we want to go all out to elect every single one of our endorsed candidates this November.
[**So if you’re ready to change the face of our government for the better and elect the Leaders We Deserve on Election Day, can we count on you to set up a $5 monthly recurring donation today? Your support makes a BIG difference.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240709-1?refcode=em20240709-1&amount=5&recurring=true&refcode2=905_587540_09ie0D&akid=905%2E587540%2E09ie0D)

Thanks, Peter. More updates soon,
David Hogg
[**P.S. Can’t commit to a monthly donation? No problem. Make a one-time $5 contribution now. Every dollar we raise helps us reach our goals.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240709-1?refcode=em20240709-1&amount=5&refcode2=905_587540_09ie0D&akid=905%2E587540%2E09ie0D)

Hi Peter,
I’m Trisha Calvarese and I’m the Democratic nominee, running against Lauren Boebert in CO-04. I got into this race to stand up for my neighbors, my late parents, for reproductive rights, and to take a stand against MAGA bullies like Lauren Boebert.
I was raised in Sterling and Highlands Ranch. Late last year Lauren Boebert realized she couldn’t win in her home district, so she up and moved to ours, where she thinks she has a better shot at getting reelected.
People in her old district, and her new district, were tired of her voting against creating jobs and securing funding for roads and bridges, but then turning around to take credit for those bills passing. They’re tired of her advocating for a nationwide abortion ban, and of her insistence on trying to gut Medicare.
Unfortunately for her, a new poll shows what my team and I have known all along: we have a clear path to victory here in CO-04.
However, that path to victory requires the resources to reach voters where they are. That’s where you come in, Peter. Will you consider spliting a donation between my campaign and Fight for Progress to connect with CO-04 voters and finally oust Lauren Boebert from Congress? Hey, it’s Jane Fonda here. As I write this, Tropical Storm Beryl has left a devastating mark. It’s heart-wrenching to see communities along the Texas coast struggle through another catastrophic event, with high winds, heavy rains, and more than 2 million homes and businesses without power. My thoughts are with everyone affected by this disaster. If you or your loved ones are being impacted by extreme weather, make sure to check in with local authorities and remain safe. If you’d like to pause emails from us for a while, you can do so **[here.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/88559992/484498514/1150891237?refcode=ea.24db05d5-3c3e-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.24db05d5-3c3e-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjI0ZGIwNWQ1LTNjM2UtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=2uNc0ZJS8wid5D1cVSH3AzuohnjwxencVxIGKwqFkMs=&emci=bbfead81-203e-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=24db05d5-3c3e-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=4823105)** Beryl is just the latest in a series of extreme weather events that have ravaged our country and the world. Our friends in the Caribbean were also devastated by this storm, leaving a trail of destruction in its wake. Across the country, dangerous heat waves are affecting over 100 million people across 27 states. From New York to Nevada to Oregon, people are experiencing extremely high temperatures, putting immense pressure on our health systems and energy grids. In the West, wildfires are raging, consuming everything in their path and displacing thousands of residents. Meanwhile, the Midwest is enduring severe thunderstorms and dangerous flooding, further highlighting the unpredictable and destructive nature of our changing climate. These events are not isolated incidents. They are part of a larger pattern of increasingly severe weather brought on by the climate crisis. And while communities are left to pick up the pieces, fossil fuel companies continue to profit off of complete destruction. They don’t care about the havoc their actions wreak; they thrive on disaster. Big polluters seize these moments to lobby for rebuilding efforts that rely heavily on fossil fuels. They secure subsidies for new oil and gas infrastructure and push policies that lock us into continued dependence on dirty energy and strengthen the industry. Every hurricane, wildfire, and flood is seen as an opportunity to increase their bottom line. It’s a sickening cycle that we must break. Naomi Klein's article in _The Guardian_ explains this "shock doctrine" — the brutal tactic of using the public’s disorientation following a collective shock to push through radical pro-corporate measures. **It's a must-read for anyone who wants to understand how power profits from disaster.[Click here to read more.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/88559993/484498515/1839883369?refcode=ea.24db05d5-3c3e-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.24db05d5-3c3e-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjI0ZGIwNWQ1LTNjM2UtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=2uNc0ZJS8wid5D1cVSH3AzuohnjwxencVxIGKwqFkMs=&emci=bbfead81-203e-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=24db05d5-3c3e-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=4823105)** As we face another brutal summer with rising temperatures and increasing natural disasters, let’s remember that we’re in this together. We need to support one another, fight back against corporate greed, and demand that our government enact meaningful climate action before we reach the point of no return. Our planet and our future depend on it. Stay safe, and know that we are fighting for a better, more sustainable world. In solidarity, Jane Fonda

According to famed UK veterinarian _Dr. Marc Abraham OBE: “The_ _ _ inability to leave the house is a common symptom of loneliness, so having to walk a dog once or twice daily encourages outside physical fitness, lowers rates of obesity and increases the frequency and likelihood of real life human-human interactions.” At our [PHS event](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=09b22ac2d1&e=c0babbc643), you will learn how you can adopt your forever furry friend including dogs, cats, small animals and even exotic animals such as lizards, snakes and turtles [https://phs-spca.org/adopt/exotic-animals/](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=3fb06c38be&e=c0babbc643). This event launches the first of many in my office’s “Loneliness t o Light Series.” Abraham continues on the Campaign to End Loneliness blog: “Indeed, having a dog by your side is often the ultimate conversation starter, igniting connections, thus reducing feelings of social isolation. Staying home with a cat, rabbit, or any other furry or feathered friend also offers a degree of companionship and interaction, including fulfilling daily routines, which can all help support and manage long-term mental health issues such as depression, anxiety and loneliness.” [https://www.campaigntoendloneliness.org/the-importance-of-animals-tackling-loneliness-one-pet-at-a-time/](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=faacc7c751&e=c0babbc643) [_**RSVP HERE!**_](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=1e910cda87&e=c0babbc643)

subject: Do you have a minute to tell us what you think about Joe Biden?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Our Revolution click here to unsubscribe
body:
[ stdin# ][IMG]

Dear Peter Willis,

The fallout from Biden’s debate performance has thrown the 2024 election,
and the Democratic Party, into confusion and turmoil. Democrats in
Congress, Democratic Party leaders, and big donors are scrambling to
figure out what to do next — but we can’t just leave it to them.

The day after the debate, we sent out a survey to our supporters — and
over 20,000 people participated. Input from our movement is helping us
inform our strategy and plan for the weeks ahead. Our findings also made
national news in Politico, The Hill, the LA Times, and more — putting the
voices of progressives front and center in the conversation around how
Democrats will proceed to November.

Now, we want to hear from Our Revolution supporters again to see how
you’re feeling about Joe Biden, Donald Trump, and the 2024 election at
this critical moment. Can you take a quick minute to fill out this survey?

Here’s the first question: [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/18607?t=1011&akid=6322%2E5885482%2Ek7zDwP ]How likely do you think it is that Democrats
will defeat Trump in November?

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/18607?t=1012&akid=6322%2E5885482%2Ek7zDwP ]Very Likely
[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/18607?t=1013&akid=6322%2E5885482%2Ek7zDwP ]Likely

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/18607?t=1016&akid=6322%2E5885482%2Ek7zDwP ]Very Unlikely

We knew organizing ahead of the 2024 election wouldn’t be easy. Now, as
Trump gets stronger thanks to the right-wing Supreme Court and Democrats
scramble, it’s getting even tougher. But we’ve been through tough fights
before — and we’ll get through this one together.

I grew up in a cabin in rural Colorado on food stamps, and went on to become the youngest Secretary of State in the country. How? In a word, Emerge.

At the age of 32, I decided to run for statewide office, never having run for office before. It was a long shot. I was up against a statewide Republican incumbent in Colorado. And folks like me don’t run for office, much less run for Secretary of State in Colorado – a seat Democrats hadn’t won in 60 years.

But I’ll tell you this – _**Emerge was there for me.**_ My Emerge sisters were the ones who showed up and encouraged me when everybody thought it was an impossible task. _**Emerge’s training provided me with the crucial strategy and support to make the impossible race become possible in 2018.**_

When I was first elected Colorado Secretary of State, I became the youngest Secretary of State in the country. So when a woman asks me what is the first step they should take to run for office, I always tell them about Emerge.

Let me tell you the truth, Peter: This is the most consequential election in our lifetime, and I need more Democratic women on the frontline to fight back against Donald Trump and his extremists.

clean_body: Emerge’s training provided me with the crucial strategy and support to make the impossible race become possible in 2018. | = | Peter, My name is Jena Griswold, and I am the Secretary of State of Colorado. And folks like me don’t run for office, much less run for Secretary of State in Colorado – a seat Democrats hadn’t won in 60 years. But I’ll tell you this – Emerge was there for me. Bob Lorinser has lived and served in this district for nearly four decades. He's running against Rep. Jack Bergman again because Northern Michigan and the UP deserve a fighter with perseverance, tenacity, and grit.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/julyad [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/julyad]
To get it done, to continue our fight, to reach as many Democratic voters as possible before the primary on Tues. Aug. 6, we need your continued support.
Every donation — large or small — is going toward critical outreach in this last month of the primary. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/julyad]
We have 28 days to reach thousands of voters, and we cannot lose momentum. We are tremendously grateful for your help.
JOIN OUR FIGHT [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/julyad]
Friends,
For over thirty years, Democrat Bob Lorinser has poured his heart and soul into serving the people of Northern Michigan and the Upper Peninsula.
As a devoted family doctor and educator, he has touched countless lives. With a decade of global experience as a Diplomat, Dr. Bob is uniquely prepared to serve us not only locally but on the world stage.
Dr. Bob's mission is deeply personal — it's about caring for and uplifting others.
Bob believes in strong communities and economic opportunity for all. Sustainable wages, affordable housing, quality education, accessible childcare, and healthcare for all while upholding our freedoms, especially reproductive rights.
Bob stands for the values that strengthen our communities: hard work, fairness, and respect for all.
On Tues. Aug. 6, vote for your family, freedoms, and future. Vote for Bob Lorinser.
Thank you for your support. Especially now, it means so much!
-Team Lorinser

Back when I was that kid sleeping on the floor of our apartment, I never could’ve guessed this is how things would turn out. When I was a Marine in Iraq, I never could’ve guessed that I’d have to fight to defend our democracy at home.

| | Hello Peter, it's Ruben. You might be wondering how this kid... **[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88562626/484507539/911663461?refcode=240709_rg_split_img1&ms=240709_rg_split&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTA5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNDlmN2I4Yi00NjNlLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=mraQmZcI9iuSUVe92FUCFvw4y3AP3RLrcaZ2aynIX08=)** ...ended up here, running for U.S. Senate, in one of the most competitive races in the entire country. **[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88562627/484507540/911663461?refcode=240709_rg_split_img2&ms=240709_rg_split&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTA5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNDlmN2I4Yi00NjNlLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=mraQmZcI9iuSUVe92FUCFvw4y3AP3RLrcaZ2aynIX08=)** Well, it started back in the apartment I shared with my mom and my sisters after our dad left. It was tough. I was sleeping on the floor because that’s all we could afford. **[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88562628/484507541/911663461?refcode=240709_rg_split_img3&ms=240709_rg_split&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTA5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNDlmN2I4Yi00NjNlLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=mraQmZcI9iuSUVe92FUCFvw4y3AP3RLrcaZ2aynIX08=)** I knew I had to do whatever it took to build a better life for us. I worked a bunch of jobs all through school to help make ends meet. **[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88562629/484507542/911663461?refcode=240709_rg_split_img4&ms=240709_rg_split&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTA5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNDlmN2I4Yi00NjNlLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=mraQmZcI9iuSUVe92FUCFvw4y3AP3RLrcaZ2aynIX08=)** Thanks to my family, my community, and a lot of hard work, I got into college. But before I graduated, I enlisted in the Marines to serve the country that gave me so much. **[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88562630/484507543/911663461?refcode=240709_rg_split_img5&ms=240709_rg_split&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTA5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNDlmN2I4Yi00NjNlLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=mraQmZcI9iuSUVe92FUCFvw4y3AP3RLrcaZ2aynIX08=)** I deployed to Al Anbar, Iraq with my brothers in arms. They called us “Lucky Lima”, but our luck turned eventually. We ended up the hardest Marine hit unit of the entire Iraq war, and I lost some of my best friends over there. **[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88562631/484507544/911663461?refcode=240709_rg_split_img5&ms=240709_rg_split&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTA5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNDlmN2I4Yi00NjNlLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=mraQmZcI9iuSUVe92FUCFvw4y3AP3RLrcaZ2aynIX08=)** You’re never the same person after something like that. And I knew I had to do something to improve things for the guys I served with, for people who grew up like me. So, I ended up running for Congress — and I won. **[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88562632/484507545/911663461?refcode=240709_rg_split_img6&ms=240709_rg_split&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTA5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNDlmN2I4Yi00NjNlLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=mraQmZcI9iuSUVe92FUCFvw4y3AP3RLrcaZ2aynIX08=)** Then, on January 6th, everything changed. It became clear to me that public service wasn’t just about improving the lives of the people in my community anymore — it was about defending our democracy, too. **[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88562633/484507546/911663461?refcode=240709_rg_split_img7&ms=240709_rg_split&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTA5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNDlmN2I4Yi00NjNlLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=mraQmZcI9iuSUVe92FUCFvw4y3AP3RLrcaZ2aynIX08=)** So now, I’m running for U.S. Senate. My opponent Kari Lake continues to spread the same lies and conspiracies that caused January 6th in the first place, and she’s one of the greatest threats to our democracy — after Trump himself. **[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88562634/484507547/911663461?refcode=240709_rg_split_img7&ms=240709_rg_split&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTA5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNDlmN2I4Yi00NjNlLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=mraQmZcI9iuSUVe92FUCFvw4y3AP3RLrcaZ2aynIX08=)** Back when I was that kid sleeping on the floor of our apartment, I never would’ve guessed this is how things would turn out. When I was a Marine in Iraq, I never would’ve thought I’d have to fight to defend our democracy at home. When I launched my first campaign, I never would’ve imagined that hundreds of thousands of people would back me up and donate to support me, either. And I never, ever would’ve thought I’d need to ask supporters like you, people who have already done so much, to do a bit more. But to defeat Kari Lake and win in Arizona, that’s what I have to do. body:
#
There isn’t just one election happening this November — there are hundreds.
So Alexandria made her _first ever_ contribution to the Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee after successfully pushing them to dedicate her dues entirely to the Voter Protection Program.
Democrats will now have the resources to protect _every_ vote in _every_ state from the MAGA movement actively trying to overturn our democracy this November.
“The entire country saw a terrorist attack on the Capitol,” Alexandria explained. **“If anybody thinks that was not a dress rehearsal for what they may attempt in January 2025, I’m sorry to say I think that’s a very naïve assumption.”**
[Will you split a $5 contribution today between our campaign and Courage to Change — Alexandria’s leadership PAC — so that we can keep building our coalition in Congress and win back the House in November?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240709-ctc.ncpDcH&refcode=em20240709-6783-P_FND_EGR_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=6783%2E2526796%2EsAbqx_)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240709-ctc.ncpDcH&refcode=em20240709-6783-P_FND_EGR_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=6783%2E2526796%2EsAbqx_)**
Alexandria made waves for refusing to pay dues to the D.C.C.C. when she was first elected, which for a time blacklisted vendors who worked with progressives that challenged establishment incumbents — like AOC.
In turn, Alexandria started Courage to Change, a leadership PAC to support people-first progressive candidates who fight tooth and nail for social, racial, economic, and environmental justice.

Hi Friend,

**_I haven't introduced myself in a while, and I want you to know why I believe what I do._**

I spent my childhood in Middletown, Ohio, in a working-class family. I didn't have all the glamor that most people in politics have growing up; let me tell you, there were no silver spoons in our household.

I was raised by my Mamaw and Papaw, and they taught me the nobility of hard work.

In my hometown, I saw my friend's parents hard at work in the factories. These same manufacturing jobs are now in danger of being ripped from our grasp because of China and bad trade deals absolutely destroying the manufacturing sector.

Washington Elites have failed at protecting most Americans. Career politicians are focused on big dollar donors, focused on pleasing their friends, and pushing their own swampy agendas. **They've never cared about taxing your small businesses, protecting your rights, or preventing the crises facing middle America.**

This is why I knew I had to run for office. I was determined to stand up to this record of failure and fight for working Americans. I'm looking out for the Americans like the ones I grew up with, the ones left behind by those who promised to look out for them.

It's the honor of a lifetime to serve this great country and the Buckeye State, but I can't keep doing it without your support.

| | Fellow Patriot, I remember it like it was yesterday. My father was working in West Africa, and we were living there when radical Iranians invaded the U.S. embassy in Tehran.

As a precaution, the U.S. Marines brought all U.S. citizens and green card holders to the U.S. Embassy. The look on their eyes said _“_ _Nothing will happen to you tonight. Not on my watch”_

In that moment, I knew I wanted to be JUST like them. **I wanted to grow up and defend the country that gave safe harbor to me and my family.**
Fast forward ten years, and I attended the U.S. Naval Academy and served for 25 years as a Navy Special Operations Officer, retiring as a Captain.

There is no honor like serving your country, and I’m ready for a new capacity of service: **representing the Commonwealth of Virginia in the U.S. Senate.**

**[Before I tell you a little bit about why I’m running, would you consider pitching in a few bucks to our campaign?](http://links.freelibertyinfo.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=ff38d4892a8146be92b5d6bf59921086&_e=-TgPMK0QTYtzw4p5xJGsNwZEpwDfI01N1D-2bGbVCYPlDxIm7jheQ6e9k6ohrG7c3df9IpeWF65DY1vsqlAD-cKcietGpDMzPRB5IAdQhm3RpUjqdCt-FUReq_cjQP76mIbFwz5Mb-vjiSVyUtFjYh8Cp8Vr5-Z10v-3dAtvGEwWSdPO2U8-49SzH_encWztIOeYZE2MrOIWBARtRRwZRjBhsNkDEiXS8r-7AJX4BUbg3lweNVqE4M8N1C3RtnJwkzrQxdylTAmH1M-cmT1Xdw%3D%3D)**
---
[**PITCH IN NOW**](http://links.freelibertyinfo.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=ff38d4892a8146be92b5d6bf59921086&_e=-TgPMK0QTYtzw4p5xJGsNwZEpwDfI01N1D-2bGbVCYPlDxIm7jheQ6e9k6ohrG7c3df9IpeWF65DY1vsqlAD-cKcietGpDMzPRB5IAdQhm3RpUjqdCt-FUReq_cjQP76zNH973_3VlfeF7uUZ-em0y66xury8SV43P_H1-x9zpdP3Xh-DGhORGVXkBeNt9nhFWGSgp84c8Xsy2aM3ZbNafXEMIrRb0QNSZq74Rf3U1ZbGVK5-s_6tmUpCGk7W8oLpx858_D_PuSOUa0KiLxBTg%3D%3D)
---
You see, there’s a Latin saying we like to use in the Navy: **“ Non sibi sed patriae.” It means “not self but country,” and it’s a phrase that’s foreign to too many of today’s politicians. **

Politicians like Tim Kaine have completely lost touch with the American people. They’d rather keep our borders wide open to criminals than take care of our veterans and our law-abiding citizens. They’re more interested in keeping special, high-dollar interests happy than serving the people who elected them.

As someone who dedicated my life to fighting for our country, it makes me absolutely sick.

I risked my life to keep America safe, and now, politicians like Tim Kaine are throwing away all of our servicemembers’ hard work.

_I won’t sit back idly and let him do that without a fight._

**[I’ve fought for America before, and I’ll do it again - but I can’t win alone. Can I count on you?](http://links.freelibertyinfo.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=ff38d4892a8146be92b5d6bf59921086&_e=-TgPMK0QTYtzw4p5xJGsNwZEpwDfI01N1D-2bGbVCYPlDxIm7jheQ6e9k6ohrG7c3df9IpeWF65DY1vsqlAD-cKcietGpDMzPRB5IAdQhm3RpUjqdCt-FUReq_cjQP76qY3PjxC6xkPTcSF-bSWmd4cI4b0Wp_tRYp81z8qYPI15odW0Vz8c7wkGRM9BUE1nsXH1iNE8OZ8QAB4qB0Rh8oJUlY5EINCcKNKQswDFXxuOEw6GekhCNlSkBxFN1749ZYGJANNoXz3QF2RQNSMDNw%3D%3D)**
---
[**SAVE OUR COUNTRY**](http://links.freelibertyinfo.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=ff38d4892a8146be92b5d6bf59921086&_e=-TgPMK0QTYtzw4p5xJGsNwZEpwDfI01N1D-2bGbVCYPlDxIm7jheQ6e9k6ohrG7c3df9IpeWF65DY1vsqlAD-cKcietGpDMzPRB5IAdQhm3RpUjqdCt-FUReq_cjQP76ZESnBxxzRpQqYvfiof4a5jnev85FDZEnyHZOWTF6qLcEHprwy9TdX7DHkRd4oM74Dr7cTJ_0YFxMP9tuVsqNjkqYQhmNqpviP2-_xTdmjK0qP2oNJdKV4zczeo-UzpxOgM_iDgVDl-4PXwmgzfVmWA%3D%3D)

**Hung Cao:** I came to America with little besides the clothes on my back. But with faith, dedication, and hard work, my family and I made it to America. I’m running for Senate to defend the American Dream that gave me everything. The Left is on a war path against the values that make us the greatest country on Earth. I didn’t put my life on the line defending those values in Special Operations in the Navy to let the Left destroy them.
